title: 第一卷·第六章

segments.lead_in: So? Who do you no tonigh, lazy and gentleman? The echo is where in the back...
segments.closing: ...we saw thy farm at Useful Prine, Domhnall, Domhnall;
segments.original: So? Who do you no tonigh, lazy and gentleman? The echo is where in the back of the wodes; callhim forth! (Shaun Mac Irewick, briefdragger, for the concern of Messrs Jhon Jhamieson and Song, rated one hundrick and thin per storehundred on this nightly quisquiquock of the twelve apostrophes, set by Jockit Mic Ereweak. He misunderstruck and aim for am ollo of number three of them and left his free natural ripostes to four of them in their own fine artful disorder.) 1. What secondtonone myther rector and maximost bridgesmaker was the first to rise taller through his beanstale than the bluegum buaboababbaun or the giganteous Wellingtonia Sequoia; went nudiboots with trouters into a liffeyette when she was barely in her tricklies; was well known to claud a conciliation cap onto the esker of his hooth; sports a chainganger's albert solemenly over his hullender's epulence; thought he weighed a new ton when there felled his first lapapple; gave the heinousness of choice to everyknight betwixt yesterdicks and twomaries; had sevenal successivecoloured serebanmaids on the same big white drawringroam horthrug; is a Willbeforce to this hour at house as he was in heather; pumped the catholick wartrey and shocked the prodestung boyne; killed his own hungery self in anger as a young man; found fodder for five when allmarken rose goflooded; with Hirish tutores Cornish made easy; voucher of rotables, toll of the road; bred manyheaded stepsons for one leapyourown taughter; is too funny for a fish and has too much outside for an insect; like a heptagon crystal emprisoms trues and fauss for us; is infinite swell in unfitting induments; once was he shovelled and once was he arsoned and once was he inundered and she hung him out billbailey; has a quadrant in his tile to tell Toler cad a'clog it is; offers chances to Long on but stands up to Legge before; found coal at the end of his harrow and mossroses behind the seams; made a fort out of his postern and wrote F.E.R.T. on his buckler; is escapemaster-in-chief from all sorts of houdingplaces; if he outharrods against barkers, to the shoolbred he acts whiteley; was evacuated at the mere appearance of three germhuns and twice besieged by a sweep; from zoomorphology to omnianimalism he is brooched by the spin of a coin; towers, an eddistoon amid the lampless, casting swannbeams on the deep; threatens thunder upon malefactors and sends whispers up fraufrau's froufrous; when Dook Hookbackcrook upsits his ass booseworthies jeer and junket but they boos him oos and baas his aas when he lukes like Hunkett Plunkett; by sosannsos and search a party on a lady of this city; business, reading newspaper, smoking cigar, arranging tumblers on table, eating meals, pleasure, etcetera, etcetera, pleasure, eating meals, arranging tumblers on table, smoking cigar, reading newspaper, business; minerals, wash and brush up, local views, juju toffee, comic and birthdays cards; those were the days and he was their hero; pink sunset shower, red clay cloud, sorrow or Sahara, oxhide or Iren; arraigned and attainted, listed and lited, pleaded and proved; catches his check at banck of Indgangd and endurses his doom at chapel exit; brain of the franks, hand of the christian, tongue of the north; commands to dinner and calls the bluff; has a block at Morgen's and a hatache all the afternunch; plays gehamerat when he's ernst but misses mausey when he's lustyg; walked as far as the Head where he sat in state as the Rump; shows Early English tracemarks and a marigold window with manigilt lights, a myrioscope, two remarkable piscines and three wellworthseeing ambries; arches all portcullised and his nave dates from dots; is a horologe unstoppable and the Benn of all bells; fuit, isst and herit and though he's mildewstaned he's mouldystoned; is a quercuss in the forest but plane member for Megalopolis; mountunmighty, faunonfleetfoot; plank in our platform, blank in our scouturn; hidal, in carucates he is enumerated, hold as an earl, he counts; shipshaped phrase of buglooking words with a form like the easing moments of a graminivorous; to our dooms brought he law, our manoirs he made his vill of; was an overgrind to the underground and acqueduced for fierythroats; sends boys in socks acoughawhooping when he lets farth his carbonoxside and silk stockings show her shapings when he looses hose on hers; stocks dry puder for the Ill people and pinkun's pellets for all the Pale; gave his mundyfoot to Miserius, her pinch to Anna Livia, that superfine pigtail to Cerisia Cerosia and quid rides to Titius, Caius and Sempronius; made the man who had no notion of shopkeepers feel he'd rather play the duke than play the gentleman; shot two queans and shook three caskles when he won his game of dwarfs; fumes inwards like a strombolist till he smokes at both ends; manmote, befier of him, womankind, pietad!; shows one white drift of snow among the gorsegrowth of his crown and a chaperon of repentance on that which shed gore; pause and quies, triple bill; went by metro for the polis and then hoved by; to the finders, hail! woa, you that seek!; whom fillth had plenished, dearth devoured; hock is leading, cocoa comes next, emery tries for the flag; can dance the O'Bruin's polerpasse at Noolahn to his own orchistruss accompaniment; took place before the internatural convention of catholic midwives and found stead before the congress for the study of endonational calamities; makes a delictuous entrée and finishes off the course between sweets and savouries; flouts for forecasts, flairs for finds and the fun of the fray on the fairground; cleared out three hundred sixty five idles to set up one all khalassal for henwives hoping to have males; the flawhoolagh, the grasping one, the kindler of paschal fire; forbids us our trespassers as we forgate him; the phoenix be his pyre, the cineres his sire!; piles big pelium on little ossas like the pilluls of hirculeads; has an eatupus complex and a drinkthedregs kink; wurstmeats for chumps and cowcarlows for scullions; when he plies for our favour is very trolly ours; two psychic espousals and three desertions; may be matter of fact now but was futter of magd then; Cattermole Hill, exmountain of flesh was reared up by stress and sank under strain; tank it up, dank it up, tells the tailor to his tout; entoutcas for a man, but bit a thimble for a maid; blimp, blump; a dud letter, a sing a song a sylble; a byword, a sentence with surcease; while stands his canyouseehim frails shall fall; was hatched at Cellbridge but ejoculated abrood; as it gan in the biguinnengs so wound up in a battle of Boss; Roderick, Roderick, Roderick, O, you've gone the way of the Danes; variously catalogued, regularly regrouped; a bushboys holoday, a quacker's mating, a wenches' sandbath; the same homoheatherous checkinlossegg as when sollyeye airly blew ye; real detonation but false report; spa mad but inn sane; half emillian via bogus census but a no street hausmann when allphannd; is the handiest of all andies and a most alleghant spot to dump your hump; hands his secession to the new patricius but plumps plebmatically for the bloody old centuries; eats with doors open and ruts with gates closed; some dub him Rotshield and more limn him Rockyfellow; shows he's fly to both demisfairs but thries to cover up his tracers; seven dovecotes cooclaim to have been pigeonheim to this homer, Smerrnion, Rhoebok, Kolonsreagh, Seapoint, Quayhowth, Ashtown, Ratheny; independent of the lordship of chamberlain, acknowledging the rule of Rome; we saw thy farm at Useful Prine, Domhnall, Domhnall;
segments.draft:
那么，如何？
今宵诸位识得何人，懒汉与绅士们？
回声响在密林深处，唤他现身吧！
（肖恩·麦克·埃尔维克，公文包提包使者，效力于约翰·詹姆森父子威士忌商行，在乔基特·麦克·埃尔维克设立的由十二道呼格问答组成之夜半猜谜大考中，获评整整一百分薄利，他误解并混淆了其中第三道问答，却任由自家纯真自然的机锋反诘以精妙纷乱之姿散落于四方各题之间。）

一、试问究竟是哪位首屈一指的神话奠基者兼首席造桥大宗师，顺遂天意且极尽偶合地在卡米蒂卡大举变现，从而自高加索山冈轴线翻滚而下，穿透时光直至永恒……这位横卧的巨灵，头枕霍斯岬角，脚抵凤凰公园，以自身巍峨身躯充当全城地基；在漫长纪元风霜侵蚀中耸峙，背负山陵重负，经历冰川消融与战火洗劫；门扉洞开而食，深锁重门而发情；有人称他为罗斯柴尔德，亦有人将他摹画为洛克菲勒；自诩通晓东西两半球万般机密，却极力掩盖自身足迹痕迹；正如相传昔日七座名城争奉荷马为故里，如今亦有七座鸽舍咕咕齐鸣，宣称乃这位信鸽老汉之安乐归宿——梅里恩、罗巴克、克朗斯基、西波因特、霍斯码头、阿什敦与拉希尼；超然独立于宫内大臣的辖制，俯首称臣于罗马教廷的统治；我们在优美海滨亲眼见过你的庄园，多姆纳尔啊，多姆纳尔；
segments.translation:
那么？今晚你识不识得谁，懒士与绅士？回声在林子后头哪儿；叫他出来！（肖恩·麦克·伊尔威克，拖公文的，替约翰·詹海米森父子父歌商号办事。这场十二呼语的夜间叽问叩答由乔基特·米克·厄里威克出题，他每百得百又十。他误撞误解，第三号全瞄了个空，另有四道，他留下自由天然的还嘴话，各依本来的巧乱次序。）

一、哪位无二的神话教区长、最最会造桥的，第一个沿着自己的老故事豆茎长上去，高过蓝桉包阿包树，或那巨巨大的威灵顿红杉；趁小利菲才滴滴答答，便裸靴带鳟下了水；出了名地把一顶和解帽扣在自家霍斯那道沙脊上；挺着他荷兰式的富态肚囊，庄庄严严亮出锁囚队的阿尔伯特表链；头一颗苹果落到膝头，就觉着自己有一新吨重；让每个夜骑士在昨日迪克和明日双玛丽之间犯下择一重罪；在同一张雪白宽敞的客厅壁炉毯上，先后蓄养七色接续的撒拉逊侍女；昔日上石楠坡，如今还在屋里，依然是股威尔必福斯的力；抽动天主教瓦特雷河，惊动新教博因河；年轻时一怒之下宰掉自己饥肠辘辘的匈牙利旧我；当全境日耳曼荒野洪水滔天之际，给五个找到了饲粮；凭爱尔兰家庭教师指点，让康沃尔语变得浅显易通；既是餐桌滚轮菜肴的担保人，又是大路关卡的通行税吏；为一个主动跳上膝头的亲生女儿，养育出多头继子；当作游鱼未免太过滑稽，算作昆虫又嫌外壳过于庞大；宛如七角水晶棱镜，为我们折射并囚禁真伪善恶；身穿不合体的衣衫，偏自诩无限气派的阔佬；一度遭铁铲深埋，一度遭烈火焚烧，一度遭洪水淹没，她还将他像比尔·贝利兼老贝利法庭要犯那般挂出晾晒；礼帽砖瓦里嵌着象限仪，专向托勒法官报知眼下几点几刻；把机会给腿侧远场，却直面腿拦三柱门；在耙地尽头挖出煤炭，在煤层衣缝背后寻见苔蔷薇；拿自家后门兼臀部筑成堡垒，在小圆盾上写下「F.E.R.T.」；是从各色胡迪尼式藏身暗穴全身而退的逃脱总大师；对着吠客能压过哈罗德，遇见舒尔布雷德却又怀特利起来；三名德国匈奴兵刚一露面便匆匆撤空，还两度遭一名扫烟囱夫围困；从兽形论到泛动物崇拜，一枚硬币旋转正反便将他别作胸针开启话头；在无灯暗夜中如埃迪斯通灯塔般巍然耸峙，将斯旺电灯的光柱投向深渊；向作恶凶徒降下雷霆恫吓，却朝贵妇沙沙作响的裙裾送去耳语；当驼背曲钩公爵在博斯沃思把屁股往上一坐，博斯沃思酒客笑他闹宴，待他一副汉基特·普伦基特相，嘘他的喔，咩他的啊；经由某某某，搜查本城某位太太，有一伙人；经商、读报、抽雪茄、在桌上摆平底酒杯、用膳、寻欢、云云、云云，寻欢、用膳、在桌上摆平底酒杯、抽雪茄、读报、经商；汽水矿泉、梳洗整容、本地风景画片、软糖太妃、滑稽画片与生日贺卡；当时正是那年月，他是那年月的英雄；粉红落日阵雨、红泥云霭、悲愁或撒哈拉、牛皮或爱尔兰铁土；受提审、受褫夺公权，列上诉状、对簿公堂，当庭抗辩、确凿查实；在英格兰银行入口领受支票，在小礼拜堂出口背书自家的末日裁决；法兰克人的头脑、基督徒的手腕、北方北欧人的舌头；传令赴晚宴，当场拆穿虚张声势的把戏；在摩根那儿有顶帽楦，午吃之后整个下午都帽疼；严严斯特时就玩格海默拉特，乐乐斯蒂希时却想毛瑟伊；一路走到霍斯海角尽头，在那里以残余议会兼臀部之姿威严落座；显露早期英格兰式窗花痕迹、一扇镶有多彩镀金玻璃的金盏花玫瑰窗、一具万花镜、两座非凡圣水池，外加三处颇值得一看的圣器壁龛；拱门尽数装有铁闸门，中殿兼肚脐的年代更可追溯至太初圆点；是一座永不停摆的时钟，也是众钟之巅的大本钟；曾是、今嘶、将继，虽满身霉点，还是块霉古石；在森林里是一株槲树，在大都会里却是悬铃木般的普通议员；山不雄，林神脚不快；是我们政纲讲台上的厚木板，也是我们纹章盾牌上的空白栏；论领地按海德、犁田单位来数，论持有如伯爵，又算他一份；船形词句嵌满甲虫模样的怪字，外形活像食草兽排泄解手时的舒坦瞬间；把律法带进我们的末日裁决，把我们的庄园宅第化作他的山庄领邑；是地下铁道上方的地面碾磨场，又引来高架渠水润泽火烧火燎的咽喉；他一放碳氧屁，短袜男孩就咳嗬咳，他一松她那儿的袜管，丝袜便显身形；为伊尔河畔的病弱民众储备干药粉，为英格兰管辖区全体苍白居民备齐粉红报小药丸；把濯足礼的星期一脚掌交给米塞里乌斯，把她的一撮鼻烟递给安娜·利维娅，把那根上等猪尾辫赠予切里西亚·切罗西亚，又向提蒂乌斯、盖乌斯与森普罗尼乌斯发问「尔等笑甚么」；教那个瞧不起小店主民族的人觉得，与其扮演绅士，倒不如扮演威灵顿公爵；在赢下矮人跳棋戏局时，射落两个王后兼荡妇，摇撼三座城堡兼酒桶；像斯特龙博利火山客那样朝内吞云吐雾，直抽得两头冒烟；男儿集会啊，在他面前，妇人天下啊，怜悯吧！；在头顶荆豆丛生的发冠间露出一抹白雪，在那曾流血洒红之处戴上悔罪风帽；休止与安息，三联剧目海报；乘地铁前往城邦兼警局，随后停船驻足；寻获者，万福！寻觅者，止步！；富足与污秽曾使他丰盈，饥馑与匮乏又将他吞噬；莱茵白葡萄酒一马当先，可可紧随其后，金刚砂奋力夺旗；能在诺兰草场伴着自家管弦乐兼疝气带伴奏，跳起奥布鲁因狗熊的北极舞步；曾在天主教助产士国际天性大会前登台亮相，又在国内灾祸研究代表大会前站稳脚跟；登场就端来一道好吃又犯法的菜，夹在甜和咸中间把菜路走完；嗤笑天气预报，凭敏锐嗅觉寻宝，在集市广场尽享混战乐趣；扫除三百六十五尊闲散偶像，为盼生男丁的养鸡妇人竖起一尊包揽一切的巨神像；既是慷慨豪爽的阔王公，又是贪得无厌的攫取者，更是点燃复活节圣火的引火人；不准咱那些越界人，正如咱忘准了他；愿凤凰化作他的火葬柴堆，愿灰烬成为他的生身先父！；像赫拉克勒斯之柱兼大力神药丸那样，把巍峨佩利翁山叠在小奥萨山顶；有个吃狄浦斯情结，又爱喝尽杯渣；把德国香肠肉留给蠢汉，把卡洛母牛肉赏给洗碗帮工；当他奔走讨好我们时，真是再忠诚不过的电车公仆；两度缔结精神良缘，三番抛妻弃盟；如今或许料事实实，当年却是少女的饲料事；卡特莫尔山这座昔日肉山，因重压而耸立，又因操劳过度而塌陷；灌满酒缸吧，谢天谢地吧，裁缝对他的招徕探子如是说；给男子备一把晴雨两用伞，给少女却只留顶针大小的一点；肥艇软囊，噗通坠落；一封无法投递的死信，一曲唱出单音节的歌谣；一句俗谚笑柄，一纸宣告缓刑终止的判词；只要他那座「你瞧得见他吗」大斗兽场屹立不倒，脆弱红颜便注定堕落倾覆；在塞尔布里奇破壳孵出，却朝四方海外喷射散播后裔；开头怎样在始初吉宁斯里开头，末了便在一场博斯大战里告终；罗德里克，罗德里克，罗德里克，噢，你已步上丹麦人的覆辙；分门别类编入目录，按期整编重新归队；丛林童子的狂欢假日，贵格会教徒兼野鸭的求偶交配，村姑浪女的沙浴；依然是当年太阳眼清晨吹拂你时那颗同质石楠的捷克失落之蛋；爆炸轰鸣千真万确，传闻报道却纯属虚构；在矿泉疗养地疯癫若狂，回到客栈酒馆却神志清醒；假普查算来是半埃米利安，全盘一清，却是个无街的豪斯曼；是所有安迪巧汉中最伶俐的帮手，也是卸下你背上驼峰最优雅的阿勒格尼胜地；把退盟交给新贵族帕特里基乌斯，投起票来，却平民般孤注押向那些血淋淋的老世纪；敞开大门用膳，紧闭城门发情；有人号他腐盾柴尔德，更多人画他作石头伙计洛基费洛；显出精通东西两半球集市机巧的本事，却极力掩盖自家的挽具踪迹；七座鸽舍咕咕争认这只归巢荷马鸽曾在自家落窝：斯梅尔尼昂、罗埃博克、科隆斯雷、西波因特、凯霍斯、阿什敦、拉森尼；独立于宫内大臣的管辖之外，唯独尊奉罗马的统治法则；我们在尤斯福尔普赖恩亲眼见过你的田庄，多姆纳尔啊，多姆纳尔；

notes.lemma: Shaun Mac Irewick, briefdragger, for the concern of Messrs Jhon Jhamieson and Song, rated one hundrick and thin per storehundred on this nightly quisquiquock of the twelve apostrophes, set by Jockit Mic Ereweak.
notes.text: 开场括注报出肖恩受哪家商号差遣、谁出十二问、他的评分及第三题与另外四题的表现。Jhamieson and Song 让酒商名和歌声靠近。出题者的家族身份留待全章照看。

notes.lemma: 1. What secondtonone myther rector and maximost bridgesmaker was the first to rise taller through his beanstale than the bluegum buaboababbaun or the giganteous Wellingtonia Sequoia
notes.text: 第一问从神话教区长、最会造桥者起问。造桥字面可另听成大祭司头衔；beanstale 兼有豆茎与老故事。问句跨数段，至 139.14 才答 Finn MacCool。

notes.lemma: some dub him Rotshield and more limn him Rockyfellow; shows he's fly to both demisfairs but thries to cover up his tracers
notes.text: Rotshield 和 Rockyfellow 可听作罗斯柴尔德、洛克菲勒，也各有腐盾与石头伙计。demisfairs 可把半球与集市一起听，tracers 仍有痕迹和挽索的声影。

notes.lemma: seven dovecotes cooclaim to have been pigeonheim to this homer, Smerrnion, Rhoebok, Kolonsreagh, Seapoint, Quayhowth, Ashtown, Ratheny
notes.text: homer 既可归巢，也可指荷马。西塞罗《为阿尔基亚斯辩护》19节列科洛丰、希俄斯、萨拉米斯、士麦那等城争认荷马。小说写七座，保留七个混成地名的顺序；各名尚未逐一落实。

segments.lead_in: reeks like Illbelpaese and looks like Iceland's ear; lodged at quot...
segments.original: reeks like Illbelpaese and looks like Iceland's ear; lodged at quot places, lived through tot reigns; takes a szumbath for his weekend and a wassarnap for his refreskment; after a good bout at stoolball enjoys Giroflee Giroflaa; what Nevermore missed and Colombo found; believes in everyman his own goaldkeeper and in Africa for the fullblacks; the arc of his drive was forty full and his stumps were pulled at eighty; boasts him to the thick-in-thews the oldest creater in Aryania and looks down on the Suiss family Collesons whom he calls les nouvelles roches; though his heart, soul and spirit turn to pharaoph times, his love, faith and hope stick to futuerism; light leglifters cense him souriantes from afore while boor browbenders curse him grommelants to his hindmost; between youlasses and yeladst glimse of Even; the Lug his peak has, the Luk his pile; drinks tharr and wodhar for his asama and eats the unparishable sow to styve off reglar rack; the beggars cloak them reclined about his paddystool, the whores winken him as they walk their side; on Christienmas at Advent Lodge, New Yealand, after a lenty illness the roeverand Mr Easterling of pentecostitis, no followers by bequest, fanfare all private; Gone Where Glory Waits Him (Ball, bulletist) but Not Here Yet (Maxwell, clark); comminxed under articles but phoenished a borgiess; from the vat on the bier through the burre in the dark to the buttle of the bawn; is A1 an the highest but Roh re his root; filled fanned of hackleberries whenas all was tuck and toss up for him as a yangster to fall fou of hockinbechers wherein he had gauged the use of raisin; ads aliments, das doles, raps rustics, tams turmoil; sas seed enough for a semination but sues skivvies on the sly; learned to speak from hand to mouth till he could talk earish with his eyes shut; hacked his way through hickheckhocks but hanged hishelp from there hereafters; rialtos, annesleyg, binn and balls to say nothing atolk of New Comyn; the gleam of the glow of the shine of the sun through the dearth of the dirth on the blush of the brick of the viled ville of Barnehulme has dust turned to brown; these dyed to tartan him, rueroot, dulse, bracken, teasel, fuller's ash, sundew and cress; long gunn but not for cotton; stood his sharp assault of famine but grew girther, girther and girther; he has twenty four or so cousins germinating in the United States of America and a namesake with an initial difference in the once kingdom of Poland; his first's a young rose and his second's French-Egyptian and his whole means a slump at Christie's; forth of his pierced part came the woman of his dreams, blood thicker then water last trade overseas; buyshop of Glintylook, eorl of Hoed; you and I are in him surrented by brwn bldns; Elin's flee polt pelhaps but Hwang Chang evelytime; he one was your of highbigpipey boys but fancy him as smoking fags his at time of life; Mount of Mish, Mell of Moy; had two cardinal ventures and three capitol sinks; has a peep in his pocketbook and a packetboat in his keep; B.V.H., B.L.G., P.P.M., T.D.S., V.B.D., T.C.H., L.O.N.; is Breakfates, Lunger, Diener and Souper; as the streets were paved with cold he felt his topperairy; taught himself skating and learned how to fall; distinctly dirty but rather a dear; hoveth chieftains evrywehr, with morder; Ostman Effendi, Serge Paddishaw; baases two mmany, outpriams al' his parisites; first of the fenians, roi des fainéants; his Tiara of scones was held unfillable till one Liam Fail felled him in Westmunster; was struck out of his sittem when he rowed saulely to demask us and to our appauling predicament brought as plagues from Buddapest; put a matchhead on an aspenstalk and set the living a fire; speared the rod and spoiled the lightning; married with cakes and repunked with pleasure; till he was buried howhappy was he and he made the welkins ring with Up Micawber!; god at the top of the staircase, carrion on the mat of straw; the false hood of a spindler web chokes the cavemouth of his unsightliness but the nestlings that liven his leafscreen sing him a lover of arbuties; we strike hands over his bloodied warsheet but we are pledged entirely to his green mantle; our friend vikelegal, our swaran foi; under the four stones by his streams who vanished the wassailbowl at the joy of shells; Mora and Lora had a hill of a high time looking down on his confusion till firm look in readiness, forward spear and the windfoot of curach strewed the lakemist of Lego over the last of his fields; we darkened for you, faulterer, in the year of mourning but we'll fidhil to the dimtwinklers when the streamy morvenlight calls up the sunbeam; his striped pantaloons, his rather strange walk; hereditatis columna erecta, hagion chiton eraphon; nods a nap for the nonce but crows cheerio when they get ecunemical; is a simultaneous equator of elimbinated integras when three upon one is by inspection improper; has the most conical hodpiece of confusianist heronim and that chuchuffuous chinchin of his is like a footsey kungoloo around Taishantyland; he's as globeful as a gasometer of lithium and luridity and he was thrice ten anular years before he wallowed round Raggiant Circos; the cabalstone at the coping of his cavin is a canine constant but only an amirican could apparoxemete the apeupresiosity of his atlast's alongement; sticklered rights and lefts at Baddersdown in his hunt for the boar trwth but made his end with the modareds that came at him in Camlenstrete; a hunnibal in exhaustive conflict, an otho to return; burning body to aiger air on melting mountain in wooing wave; we go into him sleepy children, we come out of him strucklers for life; he divested to save from the Mrs Drownings their rival queens while Grimshaw, Bragshaw and Renshaw made off with his storen clothes; taxed and rated, licensed and ranted; his threefaced stonehead was found on a whitehorse hill and the print of his costellous feet is seen in the goat's grasscircle; pull the blind, toll the deaf and call dumb, lame and halty; Miraculone, Monstrucceleen; led the upplaws at the Creation and hissed a snake charmer off her stays; hounded become haunter, hunter become fox; harrier, marrier, terrier, tav; Olaph the Oxman, Thorker the Tourable; you feel he is Vespasian yet you think of him as Aurelius; whugamore, tradertory, socianist, commoniser; made a summer assault on our shores and begiddy got his sands full; first he shot down Raglan Road and then he tore up Marlborough Place; Cromlechheight and Crommalhill were his farfamed feetrests when our lurch as lout let free into the Lubar heloved; mareschalled his wardmotes and delimited the main; netted before nibbling, can scarce turn a scale but, grossed after meals, weighs a town in himself; Banba prayed for his conversion, Beurla missed that grand old voice; a Colossus among cabbages, the Melarancitrone of fruits; larger than life, doughtier than death; Gran Turco, orege forment; lachsembulger, leperlean; the sparkle of his genial fancy, the depth of his calm sagacity, the clearness of his spotless honour, the flow of his boundless benevolence; our family furbear, our tribal tarnpike; quary was he invincibled and cur was he burked; partitioned Irskaholm, united Irishmen; he took a svig at his own methyr but she tested a bit gorky and as for the salmon he was coming up in him all life long; comm, eilerdich, hecklebury and sawyer thee, warden;
segments.draft: 散发如病态美之国的恶臭，貌如冰岛之耳；寄居过千家万户，历经多代王统；周末洗个日光浴，饮水打个小盹以提神；经历一通蹴鞠鏖战后尽情畅享欢歌艳舞；爱伦·坡错失、哥伦布寻获；深信人人皆为自家的淘金守门人；在市井泥沼中翻滚，在商会宴席上打嗝；他跨步跨过山谷，呼出满腔海雾，吞咽四方烟尘；他在教派争执中左支右绌，在法庭传讯下巧舌如簧；我们的家族始祖，我们的部族路障；何以不可战胜，又何以遭人窒息暗害；割裂的爱尔兰孤岛，联合爱尔兰人党；他狂饮一口自家的母河之水，尝起来却略带苦涩，至于那尾智慧大马哈鱼，终其一生都在他体内溯流而上；在此会见你，如哈克贝利与汤姆·索亚那般的守望老汉！
segments.translation: 臭如病美之邦伊尔贝尔帕埃塞，形如冰岛一只耳；住过若干地，熬过几朝几代；周末晒个太阳浴，再打个水盹醒一醒；打完一场酣畅淋漓的板凳球后，就乐得听一回《吉罗弗莱，吉罗弗拉》；「永不再来」漏了什么，科隆博便发现什么；信人人自家守金守门，信非洲归全黑队；驱球画弧足四十，到八十，柱桩便拔了；向筋骨粗壮之辈自诩为雅利安之地最老的造物主兼老酒滴，蔑视瑞士科尔森家族，管那班叫「新岩石」；尽管他的心肠、灵魂与精神眷恋法老时代，他的博爱、信仰与希望却紧贴未来主义；轻抬玉腿的舞女在前方含笑向他献香，粗鄙蹙眉的莽汉却在背后嘟囔咒骂他的臀股；在你们姑娘、你们小伙之间，瞅一眼暮夏娃；卢格有他的峰，卢克有他的堆；喝焦油水缓解哮喘，吃那头不朽不属堂区的母猪，顶住照例的煎熬；乞丐们披着破斗篷斜倚在他那爱尔兰毒蕈底座四周，娼妓们沿街走过时纷纷向他挤眼调情；圣诞日，于新岁兰降临邸，经过一番四旬长病，复活节林牧师阁下，患五旬节炎，遗嘱不留随从，号乐私奏；「去了荣光等他的地方」（鲍尔，弹手），不过「还没到这儿」（麦克斯韦，书记）；早年按学徒契约条款混迹入行，晚年却以资产阶级布尔乔亚兼博尔贾权贵之身收场；从灵架上的大桶，熬过暗里那团伯尔，直抵堡场的瓶战；论上头是 A1，论根底却是 Roh；年少时酷爱越橘果，当年一切全凭运气抛硬币定夺，结果一头栽进莱茵高脚酒杯里，在杯中摸透了葡萄干兼理性的妙用；添添粮，给给济，敲敲乡民，驯驯纷扰；撒下的种子足够播满整片田地，背地里却把女佣追求又追诉；从手口相传中学会说话，直到闭着眼睛也能讲一口地道爱尔兰耳语；砍开一路嗝磕嗝，从此往后吊着自己的帮手；走过里亚尔托桥、安斯利桥、宾恩桥与鲍尔斯桥，更不必提纽科门桥；阳光的微茫穿过污垢的荒芜，照在巴恩霍姆卑贱村镇的红砖晕色上，已将尘土染成褐黄；芸香根、红藻、蕨菜、起绒草、漂布木灰、毛毡苔与水芹，纷纷献身染色，将他织成苏格兰方格花呢；长枪长冈恩，可不是为棉花；挺过饥荒的猛烈侵袭，腰围反而越长越粗、越长越壮；有二十四个左右表亲在美利坚合众国生根发芽，在昔日波兰王国还有一位仅首字母相异的同名兄弟；字谜首截是一朵初绽玫瑰，次截是法埃混血，合在一起，便是佳士得一场跌价；从他刺穿的肋旁走出他梦中的女人，血浓于水，成就海外最后一桩贸易；是格伦达洛的赎买主教，又是霍斯岬角的古伯爵；你我皆包容在他里面，四围合了褐帘；埃林的自油港，也梗许，可每回都是黄昌；当年曾是你们吹大风笛的高大汉子，谁料到这把年纪竟抽起廉价纸烟头；既是米什山岳，又是莫伊蜜原；历过两趟枢机冒险，三处都城陷坑；钱夹里一瞥，堡塔里一艘邮船；B.V.H.、B.L.G.、P.P.M.、T.D.S.、V.B.D.、T.C.H.、L.O.N.；是破命早餐、磨蹭午餐、服侍正餐和晚晚汤；街上铺着冷，他只觉帽顶远远地，蒂珀雷里似的；自学溜冰本领，练就跌倒功夫；委实肮脏不堪，却又颇为讨人欢喜；带着谋杀与灰浆，在各处河堰举起部落首领；既是东来维京人的埃芬迪老爷，又是粗哔叽爱尔兰帕迪沙皇；管辖手下太多头目，比普里阿摩斯王更能生养一众帕里斯式的食客寄生虫；既是芬尼亚勇士之首，又是懒王之王；他那顶司康饼三重冠向来号称无可撼动，直到一块命运之石利亚费尔在威斯敏斯特兼西芒斯特将他击倒；当他像扫罗般怒气冲冲划船赶往大马士革揭穿我们假面时，从鞍座上震落下来，给原本已如保罗般惊骇的困境带来布达佩斯的瘟疫；在白杨树枝头装上火柴头，把芸芸众生点得烈火熊熊；戳了竿子，宠坏闪电；伴着糕结婚，又欢欢喜喜重新寻欢又结热；在下葬入土之前他何等快活，高呼「米考伯万岁！」震响九霄云外；梯顶是神，草垫上是腐肉；蜘蛛网织成的虚伪兜帽堵住他丑陋的洞口，然而在他叶幕间雀跃的雏鸟却歌咏他酷爱草莓树与群芳；咱隔他染血的战单击掌，咱却整个儿许给他那件绿斗篷；是我们维京律法兼总督般的朋友，也是咱的斯瓦兰誓友；他溪边四块石下，谁趁贝壳欢宴叫祝酒碗没了影；莫拉与洛拉两山居高临下，痛快淋漓地俯瞰他的溃乱，直到坚毅目光严阵以待、长矛前指、皮舟疾驰如风，将乐高湖的浓雾撒遍他最后的疆场；失足犯错的人啊，哀年咱为你暗过，可流水般的莫文晨光一唤起日光，咱便给那几点昏闪拉琴；瞧他那条条纹长裤，瞧他那略显古怪的步态；先立祖传之柱，再缝神圣之衣：hereditatis columna erecta，hagion chiton eraphon；眼下暂且打个瞌睡，待众人谈起普世教会与省钱之道时便高唱吉祥欢歌；当目测判定一上叠三属假分数兼不雅之举时，他便是消肢积分的联立方程兼赤道；顶着孔门英雄名录里最滑稽的圆锥泥灰桶脑壳，那番噗噗作响的寒暄叩首活像绕着泰山茅屋地乱跳袋鼠脚；肚腹浑圆如装满锂气与惨烈火光的储气罐，足过三个十环年才绕拉吉安特圆场翻滚；他小屋顶冠上的阴谋鹅卵石乃是犬齿常数，唯独一个阿米利坎能约约估个他的阿特拉斯伸展有多猿贵；在巴德斯当搜猎野猪真相，左纠右纠，却在卡姆兰街撞上迎来的莫达雷一伙，落下结局；在旷日持久的鏖战中是汉尼拔兼食人魔王，转回来又是个奥托；在消融山巅与求爱波涛中，将燃烧躯体化作凛冽寒风；我们像昏昏欲睡的孩童般走进他体内，走出来时已成终生拼搏的斗士；他脱光衣裳从溺水夫人手中救出那对争风吃醋的王后，格里姆肖、布拉格肖与伦肖三人却卷走了他偷来兼备用的衣衫；受征税、受估价，领执照、遭咆哮痛骂；他的三面石头像在白马山丘出土，他那双肋骨高耸的脚印留在山羊草圈里；拉下百叶窗引盲人，敲响丧钟唤聋子，召集哑巴、跛子与瘫子；既是奇迹大圣，又是小怪兽精；在创世大典上带头鼓掌立定天法，又发出嘘声把弄蛇女夏娃逼得解下紧身胸衣；受猎犬追逐者化为索魂幽灵，猎人自己反倒变成狐狸；既是猎兔犬、娶亲汉，又是掘地梗犬、酒馆兼希伯来尾字母「Tav」；牛汉奥拉夫，好周游的托克尔；凭触觉你觉得他是造公厕的韦斯芗，凭心思你又将他想作哲人皇帝奥勒留；既是辉格党马夫、卖国托利党商贩，又是社会主义结社客、共产平均主义者；翻着跟头向我们的海岸发起夏日强攻，天旋地转间抓了满把沙子；先顺着拉格兰路飞驰而下，接着又把马尔伯勒广场掀得天翻地覆；当他像笨汉般摇晃着放水汇入他挚爱的卢巴尔河时，石棚高地与克罗姆尔山便是他远近闻名的搁脚凳；以元帅之威统领各区市民大会，划定沧海与干管的疆界；未曾进食便落网时几乎压不动秤，饭后把毛重一算，独个儿抵得上一城；班巴古爱尔兰为他的归正虔诚祈祷，英语界却怀念那副宏亮苍老的嗓音；卷心菜里的罗得岛巨像，百果中的甜橙香橼王；比凡生更魁伟，比死神更勇猛；既是土耳其大苏丹，又是掀起大风暴的发酵大麦；肥硕如卢森堡大马哈鱼，干瘦如麻风病患；他那和煦奇想的灵光、沉静睿智的深邃、无瑕荣誉的澄明、无边仁慈的奔涌；是我们家族的毛皮熊始祖，是我们部族的高山湖收费栅栏；作猎物便给无敌了，作野狗便给伯克了；分了爱尔斯卡岛，合了爱尔兰人；他痛饮一口自家的母河兼甲基酒精，尝来有点戈尔基的涩，至于那尾大马哈鱼，终其一生都在他体内逆流涌上来；来，快着点，赫克尔贝里呀，索亚见你，守人；

notes.lemma: reeks like Illbelpaese and looks like Iceland's ear; lodged at quot places, lived through tot reigns
notes.text: Illbelpaese 让 ill 混入意大利语美丽之邦，Iceland’s ear 让冰岛、耳朵与 Ireland 近音并闻。保留臭味与形貌相对，品牌、诗句出处仍待核。

notes.lemma: what Nevermore missed and Colombo found; believes in everyman his own goaldkeeper
notes.text: 坡《乌鸦》的反复句确有 Nevermore。此处用它与 Colombo 并列，写一失一得；译文保留语法空位，科隆博可让人听见哥伦布或科伦巴。goaldkeeper 兼带守门与守金。

notes.lemma: quary was he invincibled and cur was he burked; partitioned Irskaholm, united Irishmen
notes.text: 1882年英国下院会议录在凤凰公园案中并列伯克与卡文迪什。原句 invincibled、burked 却都写成动词，可令人联想到案件和人名，也仍像说无敌、给人扼死。保留岛分、人合的对举；各动词指涉仍存疑。

notes.lemma: as for the salmon he was coming up in him all life long; comm, eilerdich, hecklebury and sawyer thee, warden;
notes.text: 鲑鱼一路在体内上游，可联想到芬的鲑鱼传说。末尾夹进口令和两个变形名字，赫克尔贝里、索亚可作吐温人物的声影，不把他们改成明确入场的人物。

segments.lead_in: silent as the bee in honey, stark as the breath on hauwck...
segments.closing: ...bored the Ostrov, leapt the Inferus, swam the Mabbul
segments.original: silent as the bee in honey, stark as the breath on hauwck, Costello, Kinsella, Mahony, Moran, though you rope Amrique your home ruler is Dan; figure right, he is hoisted by the scurve of his shaggy neck, figure left, he is rationed in isobaric patties among the crew; one asks was he poisoned, one thinks how much did he leave; ex-gardener (Riesengebirger), fitted up with planturous existencies would make Roseoogreedy (mite's) little hose; taut sheets and scuppers awash but the oil silk mack Liebsterpet micks his aquascutum; the enjoyment he took in kay women, the employment he gave to gee men; sponsor to a squad of piercers, ally to a host of rawlies; against lightning, explosion, fire, earthquake, flood, whirlwind, burglary, third party, rot, loss of cash, loss of credit, impact of vehicles; can rant as grave as oxtail soup and chat as gay as a porto flippant; is unhesitent in his unionism and yet a pigotted nationalist; Sylviacola is shy of him, Matrosenhosens nose the joke; shows the sinews of peace in his chest-o-wars; fiefeofhome, ninehundred and thirtunine years of copyhold; is aldays open for polemypolity's sake when he's not suntimes closed for the love of Janus; sucks life's eleaxir from the pettipickles of the Jewess and ruoulls in sulks if any popeling runs down the Huguenots; Boomaport, Walleslee, Ubermeerschall Blowcher and Supercharger, Monsieur Ducrow, Mister Mudson, master gardiner; to one he's just paunch and judex, to another full of beans and brehons; hallucination, cauchman, ectoplasm; passed for baabaa blacksheep till he grew white woo woo woolly; was drummatoysed by Mac Milligan's daughter and put to music by one shoebard; all fitzpatricks in his emirate remember him, the boys of wetford hail him babu; indanified himself with boro tribute and was schenkt publicly to brigstoll; was given the light in drey orchafts and entumuled in threeplexes; his likeness is in Terrecuite and he giveth rest to the rainbowed; lebriety, frothearnity and quality; his reverse makes a virtue of necessity while his obverse mars a mother by invention; beskilk his gunwale and he's the second imperial, untie points, unhook tenters and he's lath and plaster; calls upon Allthing when he fails to appeal to Eachovos; basidens, ardree, kongsemma, rexregulorum; stood into Dee mouth, then backed broadside on Baulacleeva; either eldorado or ultimate thole; a kraal of fou feud fires, a crawl of five pubs; laid out lashings of laveries to hunt down his family ancestors and then pled double trouble or quick quits to hush the buckers up; threw pebblets for luck over one sodden shoulder and dragooned peoplades armed to their teeth; pept as Gaudio Gambrinus, grim as Potter the Grave; ace of arts, deuce of damimonds, trouble of clubs, fear of spates; cumbrum, cumbrum, twiniceynurseys fore a drum but tre to uno tips the scale; reeled the titleroll opposite a brace of girdles in Silver on the Screen but was sequenced from the set as Crookback by the even more titulars, Rick, Dave and Barry; he can get on as early as the twentysecond of Mars but occasionally he doesn't come off before Virgintiquinque Germinal; his Indian name is Hapapoosiesobjibway and his number in arithmosophy is the stars of the plough; took weapon in the province of the pike and let fling his line on Eelwick; moves in vicous cicles yet remews the same; the drain rats bless his offals while the park birds curse his floodlights; Portobello, Equadocta, Therecocta, Percorello; he pours into the softclad shellborn the hard cash earned in Watling Street; his birth proved accidental shows his death its grave mistake; brought us giant ivy from the land of younkers and bewitthered Apostolopolos with the gale of his gall; while satisfied that soft youthful bright matchless girls should bosom into fine silkclad joyous blooming young women is not so pleased that heavy swearsome strongsmelling irregularshaped men should blottout active handsome wellformed frankeyed boys; herald hairyfair, alloaf the wheat; husband your aunt and endow your nepos; hearken but hush it, screen him and see; time is, an archbishopric, time was, a tradesmen's entrance; beckburn brooked with wath, scale scarred by scow; his rainfall is a couple of kneehighs while his meanst grass temperature marked three in the shade; is the meltingpoint of snow and the bubblingplace of alcohol; has a tussle with the trulls and then does himself justice; hinted at in the eschatological chapters of Humphrey's Justesse of the Jaypees and hunted for by Theban recensors who sniff there's something behind the Bug of the Deaf; the king was in his cornerwall melking mark so murry, the queen was steep in armbour feeling fain and furry, the mayds was midst the hawthorns shoeing up their hose, out pimps the back guards (pomp!) and pump gun they goes; to all his foretellers he reared a stone and for all his comethers he planted a tree; forty acres, sixty miles, white stripe, red stripe, washes his fleet in annacrwatter; whou missed a porter so whot shall he do for he wanted to sit for Pimploco but they've caught him to stand for Sue?; Dutchlord, Dutchlord, overawes us; Headmound, king and martyr, dunstung in the Yeast, Pitre-le-Pore-in Petrin, Barth-the-Grete-by-the-Exchange; he hestens towards dames troth and wedding hand like the prince of Orange and Nassau while he has trinity left behind him like Bowlbeggar Bill-the-Bustonly; brow of a hazelwood, pool in the dark; changes blowicks into bullocks and a well of Artesia into a bird of Arabia; the handwriting on his facewall, the cryptoconchoidsiphonostomata in his exprussians; his birthspot lies beyond the herospont and his burialplot in the pleasant little field; is the yldist kiosk on the pleninsula and the unguest hostel in Saint Scholarland; walked many hundreds and many score miles of streets and lit thousands in one nightlights in hectares of windows; his great wide cloak lies on fifteen acres and his little white horse decks by dozens our doors; O sorrow the sail and woe the rudder that were set for Mairie Quai!; his suns the huns, his dartars the tartars, are plenty here today; who repulsed from his burst the bombolts of Ostenton and falchioned each flash downsaduck in the deep; apersonal problem, a locative enigma; upright one, vehicule of arcanisation in the field, lying chap, floodsupplier of celiculation through ebblanes; a part of the whole as a port for a whale; Dear Hewitt Castello, Equerry, were daylighted with our outing and are looking backwards to unearly summers, from Rhoda Dundrums; is above the seedfruit level and outside the leguminiferous zone; when older links lock older hearts then he'll resemble she; can be built with glue and clippings, scrawled or voided on a buttress; the night express sings his story, the song of sparrownotes on his stave of wires; he crawls with lice, he swarms with saggarts; is as quiet as a mursque but can be as noisy as a sonogog; was Dilmun when his date was palmy and Mudlin when his nut was cracked; suck up the sease, lep laud at ease, one lip on his lap and one cushlin his crease; his porter has a mighty grasp and his baxters the boon of broadwhite; as far as wind dries and rain eats and sun turns and water bounds he is exalted and depressed, assembled and asundered; go away, we are deluded, come back, we are disghosted; bored the Ostrov, leapt the Inferus, swam the Mabbul
segments.draft: 静默如蜜中之蜂，冷峻如鹰嘴之息；科斯特洛、金塞拉、马奥尼、莫兰，纵使你们扬帆远赴美利坚，你们的故土统治者依然是丹老汉；往右边看，他遭人揪住蓬乱后颈吊将起来；往左边瞧，他化作等压肉饼分给全船水手果腹；有人探问他是否遭人下毒，有人揣度他究竟造下多少孽端；他以巍峨白髯拂过胸膛，以坚硬石壁作为背靠；耸立起凤凰公园的尖峭方尖碑，筑就都柏林城堡的深固防波堤；他的黑啤握力雄浑，他的面包坊恩赐精白面粉；凡风吹干、雨蚀咬、日轮转、水环绕之地，他皆得享崇扬与贬黜，历尽聚合与分崩；走开吧，我们受了蛊惑；归来吧，我们失却了魂魄；钻透奥斯特洛夫岛，跃过阴曹地府，游渡创世大洪水——
segments.translation: 静得像蜜里蜂，僵得像豪克上一口气，科斯特洛、金塞拉、马奥尼、莫兰，任你套着绳渡到阿美里克，家乡掌事的还是丹；图右，揪住蓬颈那道弯，把他吊起，图左，拿他做等压小肉饼，分给船员；一个问他吃了毒没，一个想他留下多少；这位来自巨人山的昔日园丁，备下丰繁繁的植生家当，可给贪玫瑰小螨儿做双小袜；帆缆绷紧，泄水孔漫水，那件油绸麦克「至爱宠」倒麦克着他的水盾；他跟 K 女人取乐，给 G 男人找活；是一队穿刺客皮尔斯的保人，也是一大群罗利爵士党徒的盟友；防雷击、爆炸、火灾、地震、洪水、旋风、入室盗窃、第三方、腐烂、现钱丢失、信用丧失、车辆冲撞；咆哮起来庄重如牛尾浓汤，闲聊起来欢快如波特翻腾酒；说到联合，他半点不迟疑，说到民族，他又偏偏偏执；林栖隐士对他畏缩羞怯，穿水手宽裤的汉子却嗅出其中笑柄；在自家战舰五斗柜里显露和平的筋骨财力；自家封地，凭庄册持地九百三十九年；只要不为双面神雅努斯之爱在星期日偶尔关门，便终日为了论战城邦的缘故敞开店门；从犹太女郎的衬裙泡菜里吮吸生命灵药，若有哪个天主教徒贬损胡格诺派，他便满肚子闷气翻滚咆哮；轰港拿破仑、威斯利威灵顿、跨海元帅布吕歇尔兼增压器、迪克罗马戏先生、泥儿子赫德森先生、园丁大师加德纳；在一人眼中他只是大肚皮潘趣木偶兼法官，在另一人眼中却满腹精神与古爱尔兰布雷洪法典；幻觉、梦魇马车夫、通灵外质；向来算作咩咩黑羊害群之马，直到须发长成一片白绒绒的羊毛；经麦克米利根的女儿改编成玩具戏剧，又由一位修鞋诗人舒伯特谱成乐曲；他酋长国里所有菲茨帕特里克子孙都铭记着他，沃特福德的少年们皆拥戴他为巴布老爷；靠博鲁姆贡赋赔偿自家损失，又当众作为厚礼赠予布里斯托尔；在三座果园郡县得见天日，又在三重坟冢里入土安葬；他的肖像塑成赤陶土偶，他赐予背负彩虹的辛劳苍生以安息；微醺自由、泡沫博爱与上流平等；他的背面化必然为美德，他的正面却凭巧思糟蹋了需求之母；把船舷修饰一番，便是第二帝制，解了系扣，卸了绷架，只剩板条灰泥；求不了各位耶和沃，就上诉万物大会；大总统、爱尔兰至高王、丹麦王统、万王之王；驾船驶入迪河口，随后调转船舷侧对巴拉克拉瓦；要么黄金国，要么极远的索尔，忍到底；四堆世仇篝火围成的非洲村寨，五家酒馆串成的醉步巡游；铺下一大摊拉弗里去追祖寻宗，又求加倍麻烦或即刻两清，好叫那伙闭嘴；往湿透的肩后一抛小砾讨好运，用龙骑兵整训武装到牙齿的部族；快活得像酿酒始祖欢喜甘布里努斯，阴沉得像坟墓波特；艺术尖儿、钻呆方二、棍棒三麻烦、黑铲四惊怕；坎布里亚归来吧，归来吧，两个冰冷小保姆守在鼓前，三对一终究压倒秤盘；在《银幕之银》里同两条束腰带兼女名伶布雷斯格德尔演对手戏担纲主角，却在扮演驼背理查时让名头更响的里克、戴夫与巴里三人接替赶出片场；早在马尔斯月二十二就能上场，偶尔到萌芽月二十五才下来；他的印第安名叫「哈帕普西斯奥吉布韦」，他在数秘哲学里的编号正是北斗七星犁星座；在长矛省分操起兵刃，又在鳗鱼湾甩出钓线；绕恶圈儿走，又喵呜复新，还是那个圈；阴沟老鼠祝福他的残羹下水，公园飞鸟却咒骂他的强光灯；波托贝洛港、引水渠、赤陶土、小绵羊佩科雷洛；把在沃特林街辛苦赚来的硬通货，悉数倾入衣衫柔滑的贝壳仙女怀中；他的降生既已证明纯属偶然，他的死亡便显出是一场坟墓般的大错；从容克少爷之邦给我们带来巨型常春藤，又凭满腔苦胆刮起的狂风吹蔫了使徒之城；他固然乐见柔嫩青春、明艳无双的少女丰满盛开为身穿绸缎、欢欣妩媚的少妇，却颇不情愿见到粗笨骂街、恶臭扑鼻、体态走样的壮汉，抹杀掉敏捷英俊、身姿挺拔、目光坦荡的少年；毛发蓬松的集市传令官，独占整块麦面包的金发宠儿；娶你姑母作夫婿，拿家产厚赠你侄儿；且侧耳细听但切莫声张，将他遮蔽起来兼搬上银幕再瞧分明；放在今日是一座大主教辖区，搁在往昔却只是商贩后门通道；溪涧忍受浅滩涉渡，峭壁鱼鳞遭平底驳船刮伤；他的降雨量足有两个膝盖高，他的草地最低均温在背阴处记作三度；既是白雪消融的冰点，又是酒精沸腾冒泡的沸点；先跟娼妇扭一阵，再给自己讨公道；汉弗莱《杰皮公法》末世诸章暗指他，底比斯再审家四处找他，嗅出《聋人之虫》背后另有东西；国王在康沃尔角落里快活挤奶赚取马克钞票，王后陷在臂弯凉亭，快快活活毛蓬蓬，女孩子在山楂丛里给袜子穿鞋，后头混账窜出来（嘭！），嘣枪嘣枪走着打；为所有预言先知兼前人竖起一块磐石，为所有同行后辈栽下一株绿树；四十英亩地、六十英里路，白条纹、红条纹，在安娜库拉河水里洗净他的船队兼双足；他错过了搬运工兼黑啤酒，这下该如何是好？他本想代表皮姆利科竞选议员，众人却揪住他去替苏珊出庭顶罪；荷兰老爷，荷兰老爷，威临咱头上；埃德蒙山头，君王兼殉道者，在东方酵母中受邓斯坦刺痛，佩特任山的穷彼得教堂，交易所旁的大圣巴多罗买堂；他像奥兰治兼拿骚亲王那样骑骏马奔向淑女婚约与红鸾喜手，背后却像要饭碗比尔半身像那样把三一学院抛在脑后；榛树林的眉棱，黑暗中的潭；把狂风海湾化作小公牛，把阿图瓦自流井变成阿拉伯不死凤凰；他脸墙上浮现神秘手书字迹，他普鲁士式的神情言辞里嵌满隐螺管口目软体动物；他的诞生地远在英雄赫勒斯滂海峡彼岸，他的墓地却坐落在宜人小牧场；是半岛上最古老的书报凉亭，也是学者圣徒之邦最年轻的客栈；走过几百几十英里的长街，在数公顷窗户间点亮天方夜谭般的千盏夜灯；他那宽宽大斗篷铺十五英亩，他那匹小白马成打装点着我们的门楣；唉，扬向玛丽码头的风帆何其悲惨，也扬向玛丽码头的船舵何其凄凉！；他的日儿匈奴，他的镖女鞑靼，今日这里多得很；从胸膛前击退奥斯坦德轰来的炮弹雷霆，挥弯刀把每一道闪电劈入深渊如野鸭潜水；既是非人称的语法难题，又是方位格的地理谜团；站时运送田野秘奥，躺着的一位又从退潮巷引水，供天上流转；作为整体的一部分，恰似收容巨鲸的一座海港；「亲爱的侍从官休伊特·卡斯特略，我们对此次郊游欣喜万分，正满心回味并不算早的夏日时光，邓德拉姆的罗达谨启」；凌驾于籽果植物线之上，超脱于豆科植物带之外；当更苍老的球场纽带锁紧更苍老的心房，他便要与她相像；可用胶水与剪报拼贴搭成，也可在扶壁上涂鸦或排泄掏空；夜间特快列车吟唱他的传奇，电线五线谱上缀满麻雀音符的歌谣；满身爬着虱子，四周挤满教士神父；能像个静静清真寺，也能像个吵吵会堂；椰枣日子兴旺时是迪尔蒙，一旦硬果儿砸裂又是泥德林；吸干四海之水，安闲跳跃颂赞，一瓣嘴唇贴在他膝头，一个心肝靠在他衣褶间；他的黑啤酒兼看门人握力雄浑，他的面包师恩赐纯白大面包；凡风吹干、雨侵蚀、日轮转、水环绕之地，他皆经历尊崇与贬抑，饱尝聚合与离散；去吧，咱迷迷惑惑，回来吧，咱没了鬼魂；钻透奥斯特洛夫，跃过因费鲁斯，泅过马布尔洪水

notes.lemma: Costello, Kinsella, Mahony, Moran, though you rope Amrique your home ruler is Dan
notes.text: 四姓之后接渡向美洲、家乡奉丹掌事。home ruler 兼有家乡领袖和自治口号的声影，丹可联想丹尼尔·奥康奈尔，译文先保名字，不添全名。

notes.lemma: figure right, he is hoisted by the scurve of his shaggy neck, figure left, he is rationed in isobaric patties among the crew
notes.text: 右图吊人，左图把人做成等压肉饼、按份分给船伙。保留图说姿态及航船语气。此处写的是假想图解，古仪式的对应待旁证。

notes.lemma: as far as wind dries and rain eats and sun turns and water bounds he is exalted and depressed, assembled and asundered; go away, we are deluded, come back, we are disghosted
notes.text: 风干、雨蚀、日转、水界之后，巨人升沉又聚散。叙述者接着连叫「去」「来」，deluded 与 disghosted 让迷惑与鬼魂叠出两个回应。续段在下一页接进第四道水行。

notes.lemma: bored the Ostrov, leapt the Inferus, swam the Mabbul
notes.text: 先钻、再跃、再泅，最后续下段的 Moyle。Mabbul 可与《创世记》6:17 的希伯来文 הַמַּבּוּל 对读，中文并留洪水义与音。奥斯特洛夫、因费鲁斯暂按音，地望待核。

segments.lead_in: and flure the Moyle; like fat, like fatlike tallow, of greasefulness...
segments.original: and flure the Moyle; like fat, like fatlike tallow, of greasefulness, yea of dripping greasefulness; did not say to the old, old, did not say to the scorbutic, scorbutic; he has founded a house, Uru, a house he has founded to which he has assigned its fate; bears a raaven geulant on a fjeld duiv; ruz the halo off his varlet when he appeared to his shecook as Haycock, Emmet, Boaro, Toaro, Osterich, Mangy and Skunk; pressed the beer of aled age out of the nettles of rashness; put a roof on the lodge for Hymn and a coq in his pot pro homo; was dapifer then pancircensor then hortifex magnus; the topes that tippled on him, the types that toppled off him; still starts our hares yet gates our goat; pocketbook packetboat, gapman gunrun; the light of other days, dire dreary darkness; our awful dad, Timour of Tortur; puzzling, startling, shocking, nay, perturbing; went puffing from king's brugh to new customs, doffing the gibbous off him to every breach of all size; with Pa's new heft and Papa's new helve he's Papapa's old cutlass Papapapa left us; when youngheaded oldshouldered and middlishneck aged about; caller herring everydaily, turgid tarpon overnight; see Loryon the comaleon that changed endocrine history by loeven his loaf with forty bannucks; she drove him dafe till he driv her blind up; the pigeons doves be perchin all over him one day on Baslesbridge and the ravens duv be pitchin their dark nets after him the next night behind Koenigstein's Arbour; tronf of the rep, comf of the priv, prosp of the pub; his headwood it's ideal if his feet are bally clay; he crashed in the hollow of the park, trees down, as he soared in the vaguum of the phoenix, stones up; looks like a moultain boultter and sounds like a rude word; the mountaen view, some lumin pale round a lamp of succar in boinyn water; three shots a puddy at up blup saddle; made up to Miss MacCormack Ni Lacarthy who made off with Darly Dermod, swank and swarthy; once diamond cut garnet now dammat cuts groany; you might find him at the Florence but watch our for him in Wynn's Hotel; theer's his bow and wheer's his leaker and heer lays his bequiet hearse, deep; Swed Albiony, likeliest villain of the place; Hennery Canterel—Cockran, eggotisters, limitated; we take our tays and frees our fleas round sadurn's mounted foot; built the Lund's kirk and destroyed the church's land; who guesse his title grabs his deeds; fletch and prities, fash and chaps; artful Juke of Wilysly; Hugglebelly's Funniral; Kukkuk Kallikak; heard in camera and excruciated; boon when with benches billeted, bann if buckshotbackshattered; heavengendered, chaosfoedted, earthborn; his father presumptively ploughed it deep on overtime and his mother as all evince must have travailled her fair share; a footprinse on the Megacene, hetman unwhorsed by Searingsand; honorary captain of the extemporised fire brigade, reported to be friendly with the police; the door is still open; the old stock collar is coming back; not forgetting the time you laughed at Elder Charterhouse's duckwhite pants and the way you said the whole township can see his hairy legs; by stealth of a kersse her aulburntress abaft his nape she hung; when his kettle became a hearthsculdus our thorstyites set their lymphyamphyre; his yearletter concocted by masterhands of assays, his hallmark imposed by the standard of wrought plate; a pair of pectorals and a triplescreen to get a wind up; lights his pipe with a rosin tree and hires a towhorse to haul his shoes; cures slavey's scurvy, breaks barons boils; called to sell polosh and was found later in a bedroom; has his seat of justice, his house of mercy, his corn o'copious and his stacks a'rye; prospector, he had a rooksacht, retrospector, he holds the holpenstake; won the freedom of new yoke for the minds of jugoslaves; acts active, peddles in passivism and is a gorgon of selfridgeousness; pours a laughsworth of his illformation over a larmsworth of salt; half heard the single maiden speech La Belle spun to her Grand Mount and wholed a lifetime by his ain fireside, wondering was it hebrew set to himmeltones or the quicksilversong of qwaternions; his troubles may be over but his doubles have still to come; the lobster pot that crabbed our keel, the garden pet that spoiled our squeezed peas; he stands in a lovely park, sea is not far, importunate towns of X, Y and Z are easily over reached; is an excrescence to civilised humanity and but a wart on Europe; wanamade singsigns to soundsense an yit he wanna git all his flesch nuemaid motts truly prural and plusible; has excisively large rings and is uncustomarily perfumed; lusteth ath he listeth the cleah whithpeh of a themise; is a prince of the fingallian in a hiberniad of hoolies; has a hodge to wherry him and a frenchy to curry him and a brabanson for his beeter and a fritz at his switch; was waylaid of a parker and beschotten by a buckeley; kicks lintils when he's cuppy and casts Jacob's arroroots, dime after dime, to poor waifstrays on the perish; reads the charms of H. C. Endersen all the weaks of his evenin and the crimes of Ivaun the Taurrible every strongday morn; soaps you soft to your face and slaps himself when he's badend; owns the bulgiest bungbarrel that ever was tiptapped in the privace of the Mullingar Inn; was born with a nuasilver tongue in his mouth and went round the coast of Iron with his lift hand to the scene; raised but two fingers and yet smelt it would day; for whom it is easier to found a see in Ebblannah than for I or you to find a dubbeltye in Dampsterdamp; to live with whom is a lifemayor and to know whom a liberal education; was dipped in Hoily Olives and chrysmed in Scent Otooles; hears cricket on the earth but annoys the life out of predikants; still turns the durc's ear of Darius to the now thoroughly infurioted one of God; made Man with juts that jerk and minted money mong maney; likes a six acup pudding when he's come whome sweetwhome; has come through all the eras of livsadventure from moonshine and shampaying down to clouts and pottled porter; woollem the farsed, hahnreich the althe, charge the sackend, writchad the thord; if a mandrake shricked to convultures at last surviving his birth the weibduck will wail bitternly over the rotter's resurrection; loses weight in the moon night but girds girder by the sundawn; with one touch of nature set a veiled world agrin and went within a sheet of tissuepaper of the option of three gaols; who could see at one blick a saumon taken with a lance, hunters pursuing a doe, a swallowship in full sail, a whyterobe lifting a host; faced flappery like old King Cnut and turned his back like Cincinnatus; is a farfar and morefar and a hoar father Nakedbucker in villas old as new; squats aquart and cracks aquaint when it's flaggin in town and on haven; blows whiskery around his summit but stehts stout upon his footles; stutters fore he falls and goes mad entirely when he's waked; is Timb to the pearly morn and Tomb to the mourning night; and an he had the best bunbaked bricks in bould Babylon for his pitching plays he'd be lost for the want of his wan wubblin wall? Answer: Finn MacCool!
segments.draft:
扫平莫伊尔海峽；宛如油脂，宛如滴淌油脂之脂膏；从未向年迈者斥其衰朽，亦从未向坏血病患斥其疮痍；他在乌尔奠基建屋，他所奠定之屋宇，早已亲自命定其命运；黑色原野盾徽上刻着狂啼之乌鸦；他建立四方行省，统御万邦水陆；每逢长夜降临便深沉酣眠，每逢受人守灵便骤然苏醒；对明珠般的清晨而言他是时间钟鸣，对哀悼的长夜而言他是深锁墓冢；纵然坐拥巴比伦最上乘的烧结砖瓦以供投石游乐，若失却了他那道摇晃倾颓的都柏林城墙，他又怎能不迷失沉沦？

答曰：芬·麦克库尔！
segments.translation:
又掠过莫伊尔；像肥脂，像肥脂似的板油，油得很，真个滴油得很；没管老的叫老，没管坏血病人叫坏血病；他立了一所屋，乌鲁，一所屋他立起，又派给它一份命数；一面鸽底盾上，亮着朱红呱鸦；当他化作干草堆、蚂蚁埃米特、野猪、公牛、鸵鸟、癞皮狗与臭鼬现身于女厨面前时，把他小跟班头上那圈光蹭了去；从鲁莽荨麻丛中榨出老麦酒年岁的啤酒；为赞美诗「他」的猎屋盖上屋顶，又为「这人」在锅里炖上一只公鸡；初任端盘御膳官，继任面包马戏监察官，终任大造园宗师；多少酒鬼在他身上豪饮，多少铅字人物从他身上跌落；至今仍惊起我们的野兔，又关住咱的山羊；钱夹，邮船，缺口人，跑枪客；往昔岁月的微光，如今化作凄厉阴森的幽暗；我们令人生畏的严父，鞑靼酷刑王帖木儿；令人费解、令人吃惊、令人震骇，甚且令人心神不宁；气喘吁吁从国王古堡走到新海关大楼，向每道大大小小的豁口脱下那弓背帽；爹给新刀把，爸爸给新柄，它仍是爸爸爸的旧短刀，爸爸爸爸留给咱；顶着年轻脑瓜却扛着苍老双肩，脖子上下也已到了中年岁数；白日里是每日叫卖的鲜鲱鱼，一夜之间便胀成肥硕的大海鲢；瞧那变色龙洛里昂，凭四十块燕麦圆饼发面烤出大面包，一举改写内分泌历史；她使他耳聋笨了，直撑到他又把她弄瞎，卷起了窗帘；有日鸽儿斑鸠在巴斯勒斯桥落满一身，次夜渡鸦在柯尼希施泰因凉棚后又朝他撒黑网；共和国的凯旋王牌，私宅茅厕的安舒慰藉，酒馆客栈的兴旺远景；哪怕双脚是巴利克莱的泥土，他的头颅森林却堪称理想完美；他轰坠公园洼处，树倒，他又在凤凰的空空里飞起，石升；模样活像山涧滚石，听起来却像一句粗野脏话；那山景，波因宁水里，糖灯附近一点淡光；一便士三枪，打向乌卜布卢卜鞍头；向麦科马克·尼·麦卡锡小姐献殷勤，她却同阔气黝黑的亲亲德莫特私奔远走；昔日是钻石切割石榴石棋逢对手，如今是咒骂切开呻吟老汉；你或许能在佛罗伦萨酒馆寻见他，在温氏旅馆却可得提防他；那边挂着他的长弓，何处漏着他的酒水，这里深埋着他安息静默的灵车；甜蜜阿尔比恩兼瑞典型男，正是当地最可疑的恶棍兼村民；亨纳里·坎特雷尔—科克伦，蛋自大有限；咱绕萨敦骑着的那脚，吃茶又放跳蚤走；建造了隆德大教堂，却毁掉了教会的地产；谁能猜中他的名号头衔，谁就能夺走他的房契与功业；鲜肉配马铃薯，炸鱼配薯条兼老兄；威利斯莱的巧公蛆；哈克贝利兼抱肚子的滑稽葬礼；库库克，卡利卡克；在密室中秘审听讯，受尽十架酷刑折磨；与长凳同住便是恩，背吃猎弹打碎便是禁；苍天所生，混沌所孕，大地所养；想来他父亲当年定是加班深耕不辍，而众皆明证，他母亲也必是吃尽了分娩阵痛之苦；巨新世上一枚脚王子印，西尔林沙把盖特曼掀下马来；临时救火队的名誉队长，据传与警方交情匪浅；大门依然敞开；老式硬高领又重新时兴起来；更别忘当年你嘲笑查特豪斯长老那条帆布白裤，嚷嚷着全镇人都能瞧见他的毛腿；她借偷吻兼樱桃之机，将一绺赤褐秀发悄悄挂在他后颈上；当他的水壶变成烫手炉火，我们干渴的雷神信徒便燃起淋巴篝火；他的年份字母由验金大师巧手配制，锤成的盘器定好成色规矩，才盖他的验印；佩戴一对胸十字架，竖起三折屏风来鼓风造势；拿脂树点烟斗，雇一匹挽马拖拉他的鞋履；治好小女佣的坏血病，挤破男爵老爷的脓疮；登门说是推销鞋油兼波兰货，随后却让人在卧室里撞见；坐拥自家的审判法座、慈悲善堂、丰饶羊角与黑麦草垛；向前探矿时背着帆布背包，回首往事时握着登山铁尖杖；为尤戈套轭奴的心赢了新轭自由；表面行事积极，暗地兜售消极主义，活像一尊自以为是兼塞尔福里奇百货式的戈耳工女妖；把值一笑的荒唐讹传，浇在值一哭的苦涩泪盐上；半听半漏了佳人向她巍峨大山倾诉的唯一处女演说，随后在自家炉火畔枯坐终生，苦思那究竟是配了天国曲调的希伯来语，还是四元数的水银流歌；他的磨难或许已成过去，他的替身双影却还在后头；是卡住我们龙骨的捕虾笼，是糟蹋我们鲜榨豌豆的花园宠兽；他伫立在优美公园里，离海不远，X、Y、Z各处烦人市镇皆可轻易通达；是文明人类的赘生物，不过是欧洲脸上的一颗肉疣；既想把歌唱符号化作音响意义，又想让自己新造的肉身妙语真正变为复数且合情合理；戴着逃税走私般的硕大戒指，浑身洒满不合常例的海关香水；随心所欲贪恋着女衬裙兼泰晤士河那清脆的沙沙低语；在爱尔兰狂欢夜的史诗里，他是一位芬戈尔外邦亲王；有英国乡巴佬霍奇替他划船摆渡，有法国佬替他刷马献媚，有布拉班特人替他轰赶猎物，还有德国佬弗里茨替他守着电闸马鞭；曾遭守园人伏击拦路，又挨了巴克利一枪轰中并溅满污秽；贪杯微醺时一脚踢开扁豆门槛，把雅各布牌竹芋饼干一角接一角撒给教区里快饿死的流浪孤儿；晚间逢弱周便读 H. C. 恩德森的奇魅，逢强日的早晨便读可怖伊沃恩的罪案；当面用软肥皂把你捧得舒舒服服，入浴洗到烂屁股时却拍打他自己；拥有穆林加客栈内室里有史以来敲开塞子最鼓胀的大酒桶；生来嘴里含着新银舌头，左手朝向陆地景致环游爱尔兰铁岸；只竖起两根手指，便嗅出天色将明；叫他在埃布拉纳立个主教座，比你我去湿阿姆斯特丹找一枚杜贝尔泰还容易；与他同住无异于终身担任市长兼做苦工，结识他本人则不啻受了一场博雅教育；在神圣橄榄油里受过浸礼，在圣劳伦斯·奥图尔的香油中领过坚振圣油；听得见炉灶地面上的蟋蟀鸣叫，却把荷兰新教牧师烦得死去活来；至今仍拿大流士兼土耳其人那只装聋作哑的耳朵，对着眼下已彻底震怒的上帝尊者；用抽动凸出的肢体造出人类兼马恩岛，又在芸芸众生间铸造钱币；回到甜蜜家园时，最爱吃一客六杯分量的布丁；历尽人生冒险的各个纪元，从私酿月光酒与香槟假欢，一路落魄到破布尿片与罐装黑啤；伍勒姆头头一，汉赖希老老，查奇二袋子，睿查德老三；倘若曼德拉草在他降生后幸存下来并向秃鹫群发出尖叫，那么母野鸭兼妇人定会在那腐烂混蛋复活兼勃起时如麻鳽般凄厉哀号；在月夜里消瘦减轻分量，到日出破晓时却束紧铁梁腰带愈发粗壮；凭一点自然本色逗得蒙纱世界咧嘴大笑，离三座牢狱的铁窗之选仅差一张薄纸的距离；一眼便能同时看见长矛叉得一尾鲑、猎人追母鹿、燕船满帆疾驰、白袍举起圣体；像老克努特王那样直面阿谀奉承与飞女浪潮，又像辛辛纳图斯那样转身归隐田园；在新旧交错的别墅庄园里，他既是祖父、又是外祖父，更是白发苍苍的赤脚老父尼克博克；当城里与港湾生计萧条时，他便蹲在一夸脱酒杯旁讲几句古雅俏皮话；巅峰头顶吹散威士忌酒气与连鬓胡须，双脚根基却稳立黑啤之上；跌倒之前结结巴巴，守灵唤醒时却彻彻底底发狂；他是珠光晨的蒂姆卜，哀悼夜的墓姆卜；纵有大胆巴比伦最好的烤包烧砖，任他投掷玩耍，他若少了一堵惨白摇摇墙，还不是得迷了路？

答曰：芬·麦克库尔！

notes.lemma: he has founded a house, Uru, a house he has founded to which he has assigned its fate
notes.text: 先立一所屋，又倒回一所屋他立起，进而替它指定命数。Uru 保音，古城及铭文联系待核。

notes.lemma: is Timb to the pearly morn and Tomb to the mourning night; and an he had the best bunbaked bricks in bould Babylon for his pitching plays he'd be lost for the want of his wan wubblin wall?
notes.text: Timb、Tomb 留蒂姆与坟墓近音，晨夜相对。巴比伦砖可与《创世记》11:3–4 烧砖建城塔对读，小说用 bunbaked 让烧砖也像烤包。wan wubblin wall 可听出苍白、摇晃以及都柏林，地名联想留注中。

notes.lemma: Answer: Finn MacCool!
notes.text: 第一问至139.14明答 Finn MacCool。四段长列举把造桥、家屋、职名、山水与昼夜归到这一答；谜底虽明，逐条仍可有别读。下一问从139.15转向 mutter 和 mike。

segments.lead_in: 2. Does your mutter know your mike? Answer: When I turn meoptics...
segments.original: 2. Does your mutter know your mike? Answer: When I turn meoptics, from suchurban prospects, 'tis my filial's bosom, doth behold with pride, that pontificator, and circumvallator, with his dam night garrulous, slipt by his side. Ann alive, the lisp of her, 'twould grig mountains whisper her, and the bergs of Iceland melt in waves of fire, and her spoonme-spondees, and her dirckle-me-ondenees, make the Rageous Ossean, kneel and quaff a lyre! If Dann's dane, Ann's dirty, if he's plane she's purty, if he's fane, she's flirty, with her auburnt streams, and her coy cajoleries, and her dabblin drolleries, for to rouse his rudderup, or to drench his dreams. If hot Hammurabi, or cowld Clesiastes, could espy her pranklings, they'd burst bounds agin, and renounce their ruings, and denounce their doings, for river and iver, and a night. Amin! 3. Which title is the true-to-type motto-in-lieu for that Tick for Teac thatchment painted witt wheth one darkness, where asnake is under clover and birds aprowl are in the rookeries and a magda went to monkishouse and a riverpaard was spotted, which is not Whichcroft Whorort not Ousterholm Dreyschluss not Haraldsby, grocer, not Vatandcan, vintner, not Houseboat and Hive not Knox-atta-Belle not O'Faynix Coalprince not Wohn Squarr Roomyeck not Ebblawn Downes not Le Decer Le Mieux not Benjamin's Lea not Tholomew's Whaddingtun gnot Antwarp gnat Musca not Corry's not Weir's not the Arch not The Smug not The Dotch House not The Uval nothing Grand nothing Splendid (Grahot or Spletel) nayther Erat Est Erit noor Non michi sed luciphro? Answer: Thine obesity, O civilian, hits the felicitude of our orb! 4. What Irish capitol city (a dea o dea!) of two syllables and six letters, with a deltic origin and a nuinous end, (ah dust oh dust!) can boost of having a) the most extensive public park in the world, b) the most expensive brewing industry in the world, c) the most expansive peopling thoroughfare in the world, d) the most phillohippuc theobibbous paùpulation in the world: and harmonise your abecedeed responses? Answer: a) Delfas. And when ye'll hear the gould hommers of my heart, my floxy loss, bingbanging again the ribs of yer resistance and the tenderbolts of my rivets working to your destraction ye'll be sheverin wi' all yer dinful sobs when we'll go riding acope-acurly, you with yer orange garland and me with my conny cordial, down the greaseways of rollicking into the waters of wetted life. b) Dorhqk. And sure where can you have such good old chimes anywhere, and leave you, as on the Mash and how'tis I would be engaging you with my plovery soft accents and descanting upover the scene beunder me of your loose vines in their hairafall with them two loving loofs braceleting the slims of your ankles and your mouth's flower rose and sinking ofter the soapstone of silvry speech, c) Nublid. Isha, why wouldn't we be happy, avourneen, on the mills'money he'll soon be leaving you as soon as I've my own owned brooklined Georgian mansion's lawn to recruit upon by Doctor Cheek's special orders and my copper's panful of soybeans and Irish in my east hand and a James's Gate in my west, after all the errears and erroriboose of combarative embottled history, and your goodself churning over the newleaved butter (more power to you), the choicest and the cheapest from Atlanta to Oconee, while I'll be drowsing in the gaarden. d) Dalway. I hooked my thoroughgoing trotty the first down Spanish Place, Mayo I make, Tuam I take, Sligo's sleek but Galway's grace. Holy eel and Sainted Salmon, chucking chub and ducking dace, Rodiron's not your aequal! says she, leppin half the lane. abcd) A bell a bell on Shalldoll Steepbell, ond be'll go massplon pristmoss speople, Shand praise gon ness our fayst moan neople, our prame Shandeepen, pay name muy feepence, moy nay non Aequallllllll! 5. Whad slags of a loughladd would retten smuttyflesks, emptout old mans, melk vitious geit, scareoff jackinjills fra tiddle anding, smoothpick waste papish pastures, insides man outsiders angell, sprink dirted water around village, newses, tobaggon and sweeds, plain general kept, louden on the kirkpeal, foottreats given to malafides, outshriek hyelp hyelp nor his hair efter buggelawrs, might underhold three barnets, putzpolish crotty bottes, nightcoover all fireglims, serve's time till baass, grindstone his kniveses, fullest boarded, lewd man of the method of godliness, perchance he nieows and thans sits in the spoorwaggen, X.W.C.A. on Z.W.C.U., Doorsteps, Limited, or Baywindaws Bros swobber preferred. Walther Clausetter's and Sons with the H. E. Chimneys' Company to not skreve, will, on advices, be bacon or stable hand, must begripe fullstandingly irers' langurge, jublander or northquain bigger prefurred, all duties, kine rights, family fewd, outings fived, may get earnst, no get combitsch, profusional drinklords to please obstain, he is fatherlow soundigged inmoodmined pershoon but aleconnerman, nay, that must he isn't? Answer: Pore ole Joe! 6. What means the saloon slogan Summon In The Housesweep Dinah? Answer: Tok. Galory bit of the sales of Cloth nowand I have to beeswax the bringing in all the claub of the porks to us how I thawght I knew his stain on the flower if me ask and can could speak and he called by me midden name Tik. I am your honey honeysugger phwhtphwht tha Bay and who bruk the dandleass and who seen the blackcullen jam for Tomorrha's big pickneck I hope it'll pour prais the Climate of all Ireland I heard the grackles and I skimming the crock on all your sangwidges fippence per leg per drake. Tuk. And who eight the last of the goosebellies that was mowlding from measlest years and who leff that there and who put that here and who let the kilkenny stale the chump. Tek. And whowasit youwasit propped the pot in the yard and whatinthe nameofsen lukeareyou rubbinthe sideofthe flureofthe lobbywith. Shite! will you have a plateful? Tak. 7. Who are those component partners of our societate, the doorboy, the cleaner, the sojer, the crook, the squeezer, the lounger, the curman, the tourabout, the mussroomsniffer, the bleakablue tramp, the funpowtherplother, the christymansboxer, from their prés salés and Donnybrook prater and Roebuck's campos and the Ager Arountown and Crumglen's grassy but Kimmage's champ and Ashtown fields and Cabra fields and Finglas fields and Santry fields and the feels of Raheny and their fails and Baldoygle to them who are latecomers all the year's round by anticipation, are the porters of the passions in virtue of retroratiocination, and, contributting their conflingent controversies of differentiation, unify their voxes in a vote of vaticination, who crunch the crusts of comfort due to depredation, drain the mead for misery to incur intoxication, condone every evil by practical justification and condam any good to its own gratification, who are ruled, roped, duped and driven by those numen daimons, the feekeepers at their laws, nightly consternation, fortnightly fornication, monthly miserecordation and omniannual recreation, doyles when they deliberate but sullivans when they are swordsed, Matey, Teddy, Simon, Jorn, Pedher, Andy, Barty, Philly, Jamesy Mor and Tom, Matt and Jakes Mac Carty? Answer: The Morphios! 8. And how war yore maggies? Answer: They war loving, they love laughing, they laugh weeping, they weep smelling, they smell smiling, they smile hating, they hate thinking, they think feeling, they feel tempting, they tempt daring, they dare waiting, they wait taking, they take thanking, they thank seeking, as born for lorn in lore of love to live and wive by wile and rile by rule of ruse 'reathed rose and hose hol'd home, yeth cometh elope year, coach and four, Sweet Peck-at-my-Heart picks one man more.
segments.draft:
二、你家老娘可知晓你这浑小子在此？
答曰：当我将双眸从市郊胜景移开，孝子胸膛便满怀自豪，瞻仰那位造桥筑城的宗师，其身畔更有终宵絮语的慈母潺潺相随。鲜活的安娜啊，听她呢喃咬字，足以逗得万仞群山欢快低语！

三、究竟何等题头堪当提比利亚斯那座豪华客栈货真价实的替代座右铭？
答曰：市民啊，汝之大腹便便，正中都柏林之祥瑞天年！

四、究竟是哪座两音节的爱尔兰首府之城……？
答曰：甲）贝尔法斯特；乙）科克；丙）高尔韦；丁）都柏林！四海九州，万水千山！

五、究竟是哪路湖畔粗汉……？
答曰：可怜的老乔！

六、“召唤女管家到店”的酒肆口号究竟作何解？
答曰：收拾停当！老妪凯特掌管历史的抹布与扫帚！

七、究竟何人乃我等尘世社团的合伙掌门？
答曰：睡神莫菲斯们！十二位嗜酒陪审大员！

八、你们家那些玛姬小妞如今战况如何？
答曰：她们往昔在爱，如今在笑，她们逗弄调情，她们深情依恋；正如命中注定要在爱情学问里为孤独而生，凭机巧度日成婚，依狡计法度取闹；待到闰年驾着四匹骏马的大车重临，甜心心上人便又挑中一位汉子！
segments.translation:
二、你妈嘟囔着，认得你那麦克么？

答曰：当我转过我那眯光眼，收回市郊一望，我这孝子胸中，骄骄傲傲瞧见，那位造桥说教、围城筑墙的人，身边悄悄溜来他的娘坝，讲上一夜。安活活呀，她那细齿软语，逗得山尖细语，冰岛的冰山也在火浪里化去。她那喂匙双重拍、转水涡仙拍，教嗷嗷奥西安跪地干一杯琴！丹若丹人，安便泥人，他若平平，她便俏俏，他若庙庙，她便撩撩。她棕烧烧的水，扭捏捏地哄，拨拨水作怪，为的是激他翘起舵，或把他一场梦浇个透。要是热汉谟拉比或冷传道者瞧见她的淘气活，准又冲破界，收回懊悔，痛斥所为，流河到永远，还添一夜。阿敏！

三、哪句题号最称款式，好顶那句格言，给「滴答换茶」的茅顶画招？涂着白么，涂着一片黑。三叶草下伏一蛇，鸦巢林里有鸟在巡，玛格达进了僧屋，河马一身斑，也叫人瞧见。既非惠奇克罗夫特·霍罗特，非奥斯特霍尔姆·德赖施卢斯，非杂货商哈拉尔兹比，非酒商桶罐，非船屋与蜂巢，非诺克斯敲贝尔，非煤亲王奥费尼克斯，非沃恩广场鲁米耶克，非埃布劳恩丘原，非勒德塞尔勒米厄，非本雅明草甸，非托洛缪·瓦丁顿，蚊非安特沃普，蝇非穆斯卡，非科里的，非威尔的，非拱门，非得意，非道奇屋，非尤瓦尔，毫无堂皇，毫无辉煌（格拉霍特也好，斯普莱特尔也好），也非昔在今在将来在，非不归我而归路西弗罗？

答曰：市民啊，汝肥肚正中我寰球福处！

四、哪座爱尔兰首府（啊女神，哦女神！），两个音节、六个字母，起自德尔塔，结于努末废墟（啊尘土，哦尘土！），能夸口说有 a）世上铺得最广的公园，b）世上耗资最大的酿造行，c）世上扩得最宽、过人最多的大道，d）世上最爱马、最饮神酒的穷众，又请你把字母次第的几答调成合声？

答曰：

a）德尔法斯。等你听见我心中金锤，我那弗洛克西失爱，乒乓敲回你抵挡的肋，听见我铆钉的嫩雷栓把你搅得心乱，你就哭呀颤呀。到时咱俩卷卷儿骑在一起，你戴橙花冠，我带小兔甜饮，从滚乐的滑道驰下，浸入湿生之水。

b）多尔赫克。你且说，哪儿再有马什那儿这样的好老钟声？还有，我拿鸻儿轻语招徕你，往上唱下边这一景，你松藤似的头发直泻，两只爱你的掌像镯子套住你的细踝，你嘴上开玫瑰，又往银声巧语的皂石下沉，

c）努布利德。哎，亲心儿，他眼看就把磨坊钱留给你，我只消照奇克大夫特别嘱咐，在自个儿溪树沿边那乔治式大宅的草坪上养神。东手满一铜锅黄豆和爱尔兰酒，西手一份詹姆斯门。在这一部比较瓶装史的欠账酒错之后，你亲手搅新叶奶油（愿你多得一把劲），亚特兰大到奥科尼数它最精最省，我在园儿里打瞌睡，咱怎能不乐？

d）达尔韦。我先在西班牙地儿钩回我的疾疾小跑马，梅奥我到，图阿姆我拿，斯莱戈滑，高尔韦雅。圣鳗鱼，圣鲑鱼，扔鲢头，闪雅罗，铁竿也比不上你！她说着，蹦过半条巷。

abcd）钟呀钟，沙尔多尔尖塔钟，嘭钟领咱上弥撒，祭司圣弥众声嚷，山德赞恩咱斋叹，咱求香迪深，付名五分钱，我呀全无对手——长长长！

五、哪些湖家小伙肯泡洗脏酒瓶、倒老汉容器、挤恶脾气母羊奶、吓走打情的杰克吉尔、捡平教宗家的荒草场，内做人，外当仙，在村里洒脏水，弄报纸、烟草、芜菁，干寻常整家杂务，敲得教堂钟大响，给坏心眼赏脚吃，碰上盗人也不头发后头尖叫救呀救呀？能养三个小崽，擦净泥靴，入夜压好炉火，服役满期才当头儿，磨刀，膳全包，走虔诚门径的淫人一位，偶尔咪一声便坐上有轨车，X.W.C.A. 在 Z.W.C.U. 上，台阶有限公司，或凸窗兄弟擦洗工优先，莫写沃尔特·克劳塞特父子及 H. E. 烟囱公司。奉吩咐可做熏肉工或马厩手，得全然听懂爱尔兰话，日特兰人或北边大胆汉更合意。各样活计，牛权，家粮家怨，外出有五，干得严实或有工钱，没得佣金，职业酒客请免。他地位低，掘着土，脑子心地是那么个人，又是个验酒官，不，他准不是么？

答曰：可怜老乔！

六、酒馆这句「唤进扫屋黛娜」是什么意思？

答曰：Tok。如今布匹大甩卖真荣耀，我还得给打蜂蜡，那一猪棚的脏东西全带进咱屋，我怎的觉得我认得花上他那渍，要是我问，罐子说得出，他还拿我那泥堆本名叫我，Tik。我是你的蜜蜜糖吮儿，噗呼噗呼对海湾，谁摔了那摇摇驴，谁瞧见那黑醋栗酱，明儿大野脖餐留的，我盼它倒雨，爱尔兰全境好气候，赞美啊，我听见黑鹂吵，把罐面撇了，抹上你们的三明夹，公鸭每腿五便士。Tuk。谁八吃了最后那点鹅肚，自麻疹年便长霉，谁把那个搁那儿，谁把这个弄这儿，谁纵基尔肯尼偷那肉头。Tek。还有谁是你是呢，把便壶撑在院里，瞧圣路加的名，你拿啥擦厅地板边边。屎！你要一满盘么？Tak。

七、咱这世社搭伙的都是谁，看门童、扫地人、大兵、弯钩客、挤客、闲汉、赶车的、团团转的、闻蕈菇的、凄蓝流浪汉、火药密谋人、讨圣诞礼盒的拳手？从盐草滩、唐尼布鲁克游场、罗巴克农场、阿朗敦田、克鲁姆格伦青草地、基米奇原野来，从阿什敦田、卡布拉田、芬格拉斯田、桑特里田、拉赫尼的田和田的失地来，直到给迟来客留的巴尔多伊格尔，一年到头都早已料到。他们凭倒推理扛着情欲，各递上分开又汇拢的争论，嘴声却拢成一票预言；啃一点从掠物得的舒适皮，饮干苦况的蜜酒求醉；凡恶，实际有理便饶了，凡善，只判它自个儿称心去。受那几个神灵魔怪指挥、套绳、哄骗、驱赶，由守法收钱人夜夜惊慌、隔周私通、月月记苦、年年取乐。商议是道尔，拔剑成沙利文，梅蒂、泰迪、西蒙、约恩、佩德、安迪、巴蒂、菲利、大詹姆西，再来汤姆、马特和杰克斯·麦卡蒂？

答曰：莫菲奥斯那一伙！

八、你那些旧时玛姬呢，过得怎生？

答曰：她们从前爱，爱笑，笑着哭，哭着嗅，嗅着笑颜，笑颜里恨，恨去想，想着感，感着诱，诱着敢，敢去等，等着拿，拿了谢，谢了寻。在爱学里生来就孤，靠巧谋过活，靠巧谋嫁，依暗法来挑逗，戴玫瑰圈，穿窟窿袜回家。又来私奔闰年，一车四马，甜甜的啄我心，再拣一个汉。

notes.lemma: 2. Does your mutter know your mike? Answer: When I turn meoptics, from suchurban prospects, 'tis my filial's bosom, doth behold with pride, that pontificator, and circumvallator, with his dam night garrulous, slipt by his side.
notes.text: mutter 能听成母亲和嘀咕声，mike 暂保麦克，也可联想到麦克风。答语把造桥筑墙者和身畔夜谈的娘坝并写，水、发、舵与梦都随声音摇摆。

notes.lemma: Answer: a) Delfas.
notes.text: 第四问先以两音节、六字母与一首府发问。Delfas、Dorhqk、Nublid、Dalway 四答名字均作变形，常可联想到贝尔法斯特、科克、都柏林和高尔韦。译文沿 a、b、c、d 分答与 abcd 合答，保留混成名。

notes.lemma: abcd) A bell a bell on Shalldoll Steepbell, ond be'll go massplon pristmoss speople, Shand praise gon ness our fayst moan neople, our prame Shandeepen, pay name muy feepence, moy nay non Aequallllllll!
notes.text: 科克市议会资料确认尚登圣安妮教堂及钟。Shalldoll Steepbell 可听出尚登尖塔钟声，译文保留变形和末尾拉长的 Aequallllllll。整段唱词及其他地名指向仍待核。

notes.lemma: Answer: Pore ole Joe! 6. What means the saloon slogan Summon In The Housesweep Dinah? Answer: Tok.
notes.text: 第五问仿征工启事，要求与待遇屡混。Pore ole Joe 可与福斯特歌曲《Old Black Joe》的题名和副歌对读，小说保留 Pore 的穷苦声。第六问的 Tok、Tik、Tuk、Tek、Tak 五次辅音顿点留在屋内数落声里。

notes.lemma: Answer: The Morphios! 8. And how war yore maggies? Answer: They war loving, they love laughing, they laugh weeping
notes.text: The Morphios 可连听 Morpheus 和 Murphy，并未指明是哪一群实际陪审员。第八问的动作一项接一项，爱生笑、笑生哭，直到道谢、寻找。译文照这一递接走，再以私奔闰年和再选一名男子收束。

segments.lead_in: 9. Now, to be on anew and basking again in the panaroma of all flores of speech...
segments.closing: ...till I've got my latchkey vote and I'll teach him when to wear what woman callours.
segments.original: 9. Now, to be on anew and basking again in the panaroma of all flores of speech, if a human being duly fatigued by his dayety in the sooty, having plenxty off time on his gouty hands and vacants of space at his sleepish feet and as hapless behind the dreams of accuracy as any camelot prince of dinmurk, were at this auctual futule preteriting unstant, in the states of suspensive exanimation, accorded, throughout the eye of a noodle, with an earsighted view of old hopeinhaven with all the ingredient and egregiunt whights and ways to which in the curse of his persistence the course of his tory will had been having recourses, the reverberration of knotcracking awes, the reconjungation of nodebinding ayes, the redissolusingness of mindmouldered ease and the thereby hang of the Hoel of it, could such a none, whiles even led comesilencers to comeliewithhers and till intempestuous Nox should catch the gallicry and spot lucan's dawn, byhold at ones what is main and why tis twain, how one once meet melts in tother wants poignings, the sap rising, the foles falling, the nimb now nihilant round the girlyhead so becoming, the wrestless in the womb, all the rivals to allsea, shakeagain, O disaster! shakealose, Ah how starring! but Heng's got a bit of Horsa's nose and Jeff's got the signs of Ham round his mouth and the beau that spun beautiful pales as it palls, what roserude and oragious grows gelb and greem, blue out the ind of it! Violet's dyed! then what would that fargazer seem to seemself to seem seeming of, dimm it all? Answer: A collideorscape! 10. What bitter's love but yurning, what' sour lovemutch but a bref burning till shee that drawes dothe smoake retourne? Answer: I know, pepette, of course, dear, but listen, precious! Thanks, pette, those are lovely, pitounette, delicious! But mind the wind, sweet! What exquisite hands you have, you angiol, if you didn't gnaw your nails, isn't it a wonder you're not achamed of me, you pig, you perfect little pigaleen! I'll nudge you in a minute! I bet you use her best Perisian smear off her vanity table to make them look so rosetop glowstop nostop. I know her. Slight me, would she? For every got I care! Three creamings a day, the first during her shower and wipe off with tissue. Then after cleanup and of course before retiring. Beme shawl, when I think of that espos of a Clancarbry, the foodbrawler, of the sociationist party with hiss blackleaded chest, hello, Prendregast! that you, Innkipper, and all his fourteen other fullback maulers or hurling stars or whatever the dagos they are, baiting at my Lord Ornery's, just becups they won the egg and spoon there so ovally provencial at Balldole. My Eilish assent he seed makes his admiracion. He is seeking an opening and means to be first with me as his belle alliance. Andoo musnoo play zeloso! Soso do todas. Such is Spanish. Stoop alittle closer, fealse! Delightsome simply! Like Jolio and Romeune. I haven't fell so turkish for ages and ages! Mine's me of squisious, the chocolate with a soul. Extraordinary! Why, what are they all, the mucky lot of them only? Sht! I wouldn't pay three hairpins for them. Peppt! That's rights, hold it steady! Leg me pull. Pu! Come big to Iran. Poo! What are you nudging for? No, I just thought you were. Listen, loviest! Of course it was too kind of you, miser, to remember my sighs in shockings, my often expressed wish when you were wandering about my trousseaurs and before I forget it don't forget, in your extensions to my personality, when knotting my remembrancetie, shoeweek will be trotting back with red heels at the end of the moon but look what the fool bought cabbage head and, as I shall answer to gracious heaven, I'll always in always remind of snappy new girters, me being always the one for charms with my very best in proud and gloving even if he was to be vermillion miles my youth to live on, the rubberend Mr Polkingtone, the quonian fleshmonger who Mother Browne solicited me for unlawful converse with, with her mug of October (a pots on it!), creaking around on his old shanksaxle like a crosty old cornquake. Airman, waterwag, terrier, blazer! I'm fine, thanks ever! Ha! O mind you poo tickly. Sall I puhim in momou. Mummum. Funny spot to have a fingey! I'm terribly sorry, I swear to you I am! May you never see me in my birthday pelts seenso tutu and that her blanches mainges may rot leprous off her whatever winking maggis I'll bet by your cut you go fleurting after with all the glass on her and the jumps in her stomewhere! Haha! I suspected she was! Sink her! May they fire her for a barren ewe! So she says: Tay for thee? Well, I saith: Angst so mush: and desired she might not take it amiss if I esteemed her but an odd. If I did ate toughturf I'm not a mishymissy. Of course I know, pettest, you're so learningful and considerate in yourself, so friend of vegetables, you long cold cat you! Please by acquiester to meek my acquointance! Codling, snakelet, iciclist! My diaper has more life to it! Who drowned you in drears, man, or are you pillale with ink? Did a weep get past the gates of your pride? My tread on the clover, sweetness? Yes, the buttercups told me, hug me, damn it all, and I'll kiss you back to life, my peachest. I mean to make you suffer, meddlar, and I don't care this fig for contempt of courting. That I chid you, sweet sir? You know I'm tender by my eye. Can't you read by dazzling ones through me true? Bite my laughters, drink my tears. Pore into me, volumes, spell me stark and spill me swooning. I just don't care what my thwarters think. Transname me loveliness, now and here me for all times! I'd risk a policeman passing by, Magrath or even that beggar of a boots at the Post. The flame? O, pardone! That was what? Ah, did you speak, stuffstuff? More poestries from Chickspeer's with gleechoreal music or a jaculation from the garden of the soul. Of I be leib in the immoralities? O, you mean the strangle for love and the sowiveall of the prettiest? Yep, we open hap coseries in the home. And once upon a week I improve on myself I'm so keen on that New Free Woman with novel inside. I'm always as tickled as can be over Man in a Surplus by the Lady who Pays the Rates. But I'm as pie as is possible. Let's root out Brimstoker and give him the thrall of our lives. It's Dracula's nightout. For creepsake don't make a flush! Draw the shades, curfe you, and I'll beat any sonnamonk to love. Holy bug, how my highness would jump to make you flame your halve a bannan in two when I'd run my burning torchlight through (to adore me there and then cease to be? Whatever for, blossoms?) Your hairmejig if you had one. If I am laughing with you? No, lovingest, I'm not so dying to take my rise out of you, adored. Not in the very least. True as God made my Mamaw hiplength modesty coatmawther! It's only because the rison is I'm only any girl, you lovely fellow of my dreams, and because old somebooby is not a roundabout, my trysting of the tulipies, like that puff pape bucking Daveran assoiling us behinds. What a nerve! He thinks that's what the vesprey's for. How vain's that hope in cleric's heart Who still pursues th'adult' rous art, Cocksure that rusty gown of his Will make fair Sue forget his phiz! Tame Schwipps. Blessed Marguerite bosses, I hope they threw away the mould or else we'll have Ballshossers and Sourdamapplers with their medical assassiations all over the place. But hold hard till I've got my latchkey vote and I'll teach him when to wear what woman callours. On account of the gloss of the gleison
segments.draft:
九、如今，且让我们重振旗鼓，再度沐浴在通篇辞藻的烂漫花海之中……试问这等万象纷呈的奇妙宇宙究竟为何物？
答曰：碰撞万花筒！

十、苦涩之爱若非焦渴渴盼，酸楚之恋若非凄凉痛失，稚子之痴、姜汁之辛、带刺欢愉究竟作何解？
答曰：我全知晓，小宝贝，自然啦，亲爱的，但且倾听幽暗中的声息……我知道你心里全明白，我的镜中妹子，悄悄梳理秀发，系好丝带，切莫让旁人偷听了闺中私语；那位老教士满腔淫靡，仍妄图追逐偷香窃玉之术，自命不凡地以为凭他那件生锈破黑袍，定能教纯洁苏珊忘却他的丑陋嘴脸！且慢，待我拿到自家门钥匙并拥有投票权，我定教他懂得何时才配穿戴妇人赏赐的斑斓色彩！
segments.translation:
九、再开场，再晒一晒百花百话的全景：倘有这么一个人，尘煤城里过了一日，活也活累了，痛风手里空着大把钟点，困脚底下空出大片地方，又落在准头的梦后，倒霉得像昏暗丹国的哪位卡默洛王子；倘在这个实有的、未将来却正在过去的一霎，气悬息歇，从一孔面条眼里，让他用耳朵望一望老希望港，望见里里外外诸般人物道路，那是他执拗托利志一路咒咒地常去借重的；还有裂结的惊哦震来震去，系扣的应哎拆开又接，脑模里那安逸再溶再散，连那整套霍埃尔怎么挂；那这么一个无名无某，可会趁人引默客来和她躺，又赶在闯夜神诺克斯拾到雄鸡叫、点出卢坎曙色之前，一眼看出什么是主、怎么又成两端，一次相逢怎么熔进另一边渴求的刺，汁上升，叶下落，恰衬小姑娘的头光此刻一圈归无，胎里静不住，众争客归众海？再摇一把，啊灾殃！摇开摇散，啊多耀星！可亨带了霍萨一点鼻子，杰夫口边一圈含的记号，那美男儿旋得美，颜色淡而又暗；玫粗红、橙烈烈，变成盖尔布黄、格里姆绿，蓝吹掉靛头！紫罗兰染死了！那么见鬼吧，那望远客在自己眼里，似乎会自觉仿佛又像个什么？

答曰：一架撞景万花筒！

十、苦爱除了渴盼，还有甚么，酸爱配除了烧一小会儿，还有甚么，直等吸烟的她把烟吐还？

答曰：我懂，佩佩特，当然啦，亲爱的，可听啊，宝贝！谢谢，佩特，那些真好，皮图内特，真香！不过当心风，甜心！你这双巧手多精致啊，你这小天使，要是你不咬指甲就更好了，你竟不替我害臊，岂不怪哉，你这小猪猡，你这十全十美的小乳猪！我过一秒钟就要用胳膊肘捅你啦！我敢打赌，你准是偷用了她梳妆台上最上等的巴黎香脂，才把它们抹得玫尖尖、红亮亮、停不下。我认得她。她竟敢怠慢我？我才不稀罕呢！一天涂三次润肤霜，头一回在淋浴时涂，涂完拿纸巾擦掉；再是收拾干净以后，当然睡前还来一回。凭我披肩，一想起克兰卡布里的那位吃食斗汉，社团党那位，胸前擦了黑铅，喂，普伦德加斯特！你呀，店掌柜，还有另外十四个猛后卫、赫林球星，反正是哪路人，在奥纳里老爷那儿歇脚吃食，就因为在巴尔多尔赢了蛋匙竞走，赢得那么椭圆、那么外省。他瞧见我那艾莉什口音又点头，便满心阿德米拉西翁。他正寻觅空子，盘算着同我缔结「美丽联盟」拔得头筹。安都，莫作个泽洛索！索索，都托达斯。这便是西班牙话。再俯身凑近一点，假心人！简直妙不可言！活像朱利奥和罗梅尤娜。我好久好久没这么托土耳其的福啦！我的嘛，是爱斯奎西厄斯，那有魂的巧克力。太奇妙了！哼，他们那帮浑身泥垢的家伙，一个个都算甚么东西？嘘！我才不肯为他们花三根发夹呢。噗！这就对了，拿稳它！让我来拉一把。噗！大个儿来伊朗呀。噗！你干吗用肘子捅人？没呀，我刚当是你在捅。

听着，最心爱的人！你这小守财奴，亏你还记得我望着长筒丝袜发出的叹息，记得你翻看我嫁妆箱时我屡屡吐露的心愿；且趁我还记得，你把我这人儿添长、替我结起挂念带时，千万别忘了：月底月亮亏尽时，鞋子周就要踩着红高跟小跑回来啦；可你瞧那个卷心菜脑袋傻瓜买回些甚么玩意儿！我敢对慈悲上苍发誓，我永远永远都会惦记着时髦的新吊袜带，毕竟我向来最讲究穿戴齐整、手套光鲜、仪态万方；哪怕他离我年轻岁数足有朱红百万哩，那位橡皮敬牧波金顿先生——就是布朗妈妈端着十月麦酒（见鬼去吧！）拉皮条劝我与他私通的那个老皮肉贩子——踩两条老胫轴嘎吱转，活像只硬皮老玉米震。飞行员、水鹡鸰、小梗犬、花花公子！我好得很，多谢多谢！哈！哎，当心，怪痒呀。搁他进我嘴嘴么。姆姆。指头搁那儿真怪！我实在抱歉极了，我对你发誓！愿你永远瞧不见我穿生日皮衣、现身短裙；愿她白手爪麻烂掉落，不管哪个使眼色的玛姬，瞧你那式样准又追着撩，她一身玻璃闪，甚么地方还一蹦一跳！哈哈！我早猜到她是那种货色！淹死她！愿众人把她当不生羔子的母羊烧掉！于是她说：请你喝茶？哼，我便说：安格斯，索马什；还请她莫要见怪，我看她不过一个零头。哪怕我嚼过硬草皮，我也绝非娇滴滴的小姐。最乖的宝贝，我自然明白，你本身既有学问又体贴入微，跟蔬菜花草那么亲近，你这只又长又冷的猫儿！请惠然默允，温温顺顺认个识吧！小鳕鱼、小幼蛇、冰柱客！我的尿布都比你更有生气！汉子啊，是谁把你淹在凄凉眼泪里，还是你喝墨水喝得脸色苍白？莫非有一滴泪水闯过了你骄傲的城门？甜心，你说我踩了三叶草？是呀，毛茛花已经告诉我了，抱紧我，见鬼去吧，我的甜桃儿，让我吻得你起死回生。

我偏要教你受折磨，你这爱管闲事的家伙，甚么藐视求爱法庭之罪，我连半颗无花果都不在乎。甜心先生，你说我责骂了你？看我的眼神你便知道我有多温柔。难道你没法透过我耀眼的双眸看穿我的真心吗？咬碎我的欢笑，饮尽我的泪水吧。整卷整卷读进我，拼出赤裸一个我，再把我泼倒晕去。那些阻挠我的人怎么想，我压根儿不在乎。就在此地此刻，改我名叫「好可爱」，听我在这儿，也听我到永远！哪怕有巡警打旁边经过——无论是麦格拉思，还是邮局里那个擦靴子的叫花子——我也甘愿冒这个险。你说火苗？噢，抱愧！刚才那是甚么？啊，小东西，你刚才说话了吗？再来几首莎士比亚配欢快合唱乐的诗篇，或者从灵魂花园里射出一声惊叹祷词吧。你问我信不信不朽与不道德？噢，你是指为爱窒息搏杀与最美者生存吗？没错，我们在家里开办快活亲昵的清谈会。每个礼拜我都会自我长进一回，我着迷那份里头有新意、有小说的《新自由女性》。每次读到那位交地方税的淑女所写的《有余男，穿白衣》，我总乐得合不拢嘴。不过我本人可是再虔诚乖巧不过的了。

咱掘出布林斯托克，奉他咱一辈子的迷魂。德古拉夜出啦。爬行保佑，千万别一冲一红！拉下窗帘，该死的家伙，在情场上我敢击败任何梦游小和尚。圣甲虫啊，要是我举起熊熊手电筒照穿你那玩意儿（就在那儿崇拜我，随后立刻化为乌有？花朵儿，那又是何苦呢？），你若还有一头发摆摆，我高贵的殿下也会欢跳起来，叫你把半根香蕉烧成两截。问我可是在同你笑？没呀，最可爱的人，我哪有那么急着拿你逗我的乐、起我的兴呀，心上人。一丝一毫都没有。千真万确，就如上帝做了我妈嬷那件齐臀遮体大衣，千真万确！唯一的缘故只在于，我不过是个寻常少女罢了，我梦中的俊俏郎君；况且那个老傻瓜又不是旋转木马——我郁金香花丛间的幽会情郎——不像那个喘气如吹泡、放荡乱跳的达弗兰神父，专从背后赦免我们的罪过。好大的胆子！他还以为晚祷就是干这个用的呢。

教士心头这愿望，

偷香手艺还不放，

凭他那件旧袍裳，

俏苏准忘这脸相！

淡淡施韦普斯。仁慈的玛格丽特老板娘啊，但愿他们早就砸碎了那个模子，否则满街都要挤满巴尔绍瑟与酸塔苹果佬，连同那帮医会谋会了。且慢，等我拿到门匙选票，定教他何时穿甚么女人色。为了格莱森那一层光泽

notes.lemma: Answer: A collideorscape!
notes.text: 长问末尾依次把玫红、橙、黄、绿、蓝、靛、紫变成动词、异语和变形词。答语 collideorscape 把碰撞、万花筒和景观凑在一起，另有 escape 声影。中译暂用撞景。

notes.lemma: Answer: I know, pepette, of course, dear, but listen, precious!
notes.text: 以 pepette、pette、pitounette 交替称人，独语在梳妆、嫉妒、耳语和读书间跳转。读者可从书名对照 1913 年《The New Freewoman》期刊档案、斯托克《德古拉》。口中的人及影子是否同一位，尚可别读。

notes.lemma: How vain's that hope in cleric's heart Who still pursues th'adult' rous art, Cocksure that rusty gown of his Will make fair Sue forget his phiz!
notes.text: 原文将四个押韵分句嵌在独白内，嘲讽教士想凭旧袍叫俏苏忘掉他的脸。译文按四句另排，诗句具体来历待核。

In th' amourlight, O my darling! No, I swear to you by Fibsburrow churchdome and Sainte Andrée's Undershift, by all I hold secret from my world and in my underworld of nighties and naughties and all the other wonderwearlds! Now open, pet, your lips, pepette, like I used my sweet parted lipsabuss with Dan Holohan of facetious memory taught me after the flannel dance, with the proof of love, up Smock Alley the first night he smelled pouder and I coloured beneath my fan, pipetta mia, when you learned me the linguo to melt. Your delighted lips, love, be careful! Mind my duvetyne dress above all! It's golded silvy, the newest sextones with princess effect. For Rutland blue's got out of passion. So, so, my precious! No! Not even to the charmermaid? How marfellows! Of course I believe you, my own dear doting liest, when you tell me. As I'd live to, O, I'd love to! Liss, liss! I muss whiss! With my whiteness I thee woo and bind my silk breasths I thee bound! Always, Amory, amor andmore! Till always, thou lovest! Shshshsh! So long as the lucksmith. Laughs!
segments.draft: 鉴于格莱森的光泽，哈萨布布拉比何其娇艳迷人。况且，你这没种的瘦竹竿呆汉，我恨透了想起你的念头；然而，我的心肝，自然啦，最亲爱的人，我生来注定要许配给法国学院的工程师冤家做夫婿；当你在读书识字中安身立命，我们便签约立誓永结同心。切莫让那帮嫉妒的长舌泼妇偷看我们的密信，她们的嘴脸比酸苹果还要酸涩！以我的皎洁我向你求爱，以我的绸缎酥胸我将你缚紧！永远，阿莫里，爱煞更爱！直至永远，只要你深爱！嘘嘘嘘嘘！只要那铸运铁匠欢笑不止！
segments.translation:
哈萨布布拉比是个博贝尔。再说因为，你这没胆儿的瘦愣子，我连想起想到你都恨，又因为，亲亲呀，自然啦，最可爱的人呀，我本来就许给法国学院那位工程亲哥，必夫一位，诺姆丹吉安，等咱说愿意、订下契约，恩乔滕乔解一回，你便跟读书写字成亲。请办的这件事可耽搁不了多久，他呀绕着我发痴，我也一蹦蹦向着他。打那天起，他，我的救星艾罗斯，从船上抱我到岸，我在他肩上留了一根浅发，给他的手和心引路，摸到那点柔软。

真是抱歉万分！请原谅，我正听我说的每一句宝贝话，它们从我亲爱的妈舌上掉下来。不然我怎能看出你在想咱姥姥甚么？我只是犯嘀咕，不知自己倒掉剃毛水没有。不管怎样，小鸡脖子，挽住我的胳膊吧。优雅归属于你。你的嘴往我嘴这儿来，带点薄荷香，再来，最宝贝，再过来一点！哄我开心吧，心肝。别耍脾气，我才不会那样呢！嘘！没事！不知哪儿有只蟋蟀在叫！拜拜，买买！我机灵着呢！听呀，小乖乖，就在菩提树荫下。你晓得大树都挨着、也都反着墓碑。它们嘶嘶听着，嘶嘶停着。加恩德昂曼德！所以，小舞男，看在米戈的份上，快叽叽喳喳欢叫起来吧！那扇小小便门，我走在你前头，就这样，你便站到了我的围裙舞台前。小鸽子，他害羞了吗？千万别忘了台下还有观众呢。天使啊，我早就迷失沉沦了。抱紧我，你这小魔鬼！这是咱俩的嘟对嘟。

听呀听呀！轰动全场！由他们去，整四场法庭求爱！由他们去吧，大嚷汉和那十一个喝酒的，合十二个地方兵。那个「老酒鬼洞穴」偏要宽阔大街才够他们胡闹撒野，米切尔对尼科尔斯那场。飞鸟、林子、水、谷！还有我那二十只守在栅栏台阶上等候的同班小鸟！让我拿手指拨一拨她们的韵律算术。你也好瞧瞧我是不是自个儿想的。她们都想逗人欢喜。且慢！奉……之名。加上全副冬青。还有些槲寄生，还添个圣伊夫。咳咳！嗯哼！这儿有阿达、贝特、西莉亚、迪莉娅、伊娜、弗蕾塔、吉尔达、希尔达、伊塔、杰丝、凯蒂、露（照读准叫我咳）、米娜、尼帕、奥普西、波尔、奎妮、露丝、索西、特里克西、乌娜、薇拉、旺达、克塞妮娅、伊娃、祖尔玛、菲比、塞尔玛。再加我我！感化院小子直奔上教堂，咱也一道来吃，像大伙晚餐，又从普拉维登斯姨那里领来唇赦，为桃金娘罪罚苦修。

她们那新娘一成亲，我的美铃人全蒂汀一响。铃一圈呀，玫瑰铃一圈！人人都会听见。谁的愿，是我思绪的远父。等她们跟日间保姆上伴游街，我便给那无男闲话种一问，看谁答得着。普天之下明艳的白鸽，脖子上系着情丝缎带，都将衔着我的槲寄生密信展翅飞翔，替每一位贞洁女神带去我的一块喜饼碎屑。凡有字纸文件，我们一概妥善保存。在爱神微光里，噢，我的心上人！

不，我敢凭斐布斯伯勒教堂圆顶与圣安德蕾底衫对你发誓，指着我向尘世隐瞒的一切秘密，指着我睡衣与淘气勾当的地下世界以及所有其他奇妙世界起誓！闭上你的，不许看！现在开开，乖乖，你的嘴唇，佩佩特，好比我当年那甜甜半张的吻，是记来好笑的丹·霍洛汉教我的，法兰绒舞后，凭一件爱证，在斯莫克巷，头一夜他闻见粉气，我在扇底下上颜色，小皮佩塔呀，是你教我那套会熔化的话。黑发郎君啊，谁能长着像咱俩这样的顺风耳！沉默寡言的人儿，你喜欢那样吗？这个小小的我，你喜欢么，我的命，我的爱？你为甚么喜欢听我耳语？这难道不是如神仙般甜美迷人吗？可这在你面前岂不叫人难为情？猫咪，猫咪！快告诉我，直讲到我的颤颤劲上来！

我绝不拆开封印。我依然享受得很，我发誓我是！我的小甜心，容我问一句，你为甚么偏偏喜欢钻在这些暗黑罗网里呢？嘘，嘘！长耳朵正飞过来呢。不，最甜的宝贝，那怎么会惹我心烦呢？可是别这样！你再这样就该结结实实挨一顿巴掌啦。亲爱的，当心你那欢喜贪馋的嘴唇！尤其当心我这身杜维廷绒裙！它闪着金银双色光泽，正是带公主裙效的最新六音色款式。毕竟拉特兰蓝色眼下已经过时失宠了。就这样，就这样，我的心肝宝贝！噢，亲爱的，我瞧得出这代价有多高！不用告诉我！哼，连羊巷里的小童都晓得那档子事。若我卖，卖谁家的，亲亲？难道我在这里卖过，泪儿？你是指那些印着情话的薄荷糖锭？太可怕了！真叫我羞煞愧煞！小雏鸡们，我才不干呢，哪怕把银河里所有的朱丽叶都给我也不干！在床上看见她们朝我使眼色，我真能把她们咬个脆响。我的未婚夫，我可没那么做过，也没打算或动念那么做。嘘嘘嘘！别那样一惊一乍的，你这坏坯！你这位大作家，我原以为你无所不知、无所不晓，能用你那支新式雾云铅笔，向世人阐明他们各自旧体系的意思呢。

那不过又是布林布鲁那条该死的古老诡诈河里冒出的另一条怪鱼罢了，哥特愿哥特保佑咱，饶她吧！犄角也歇了那顶顶吧！亲爱的，原谅我赌咒发誓，我指着乌兰宝座上的撒拉逊人起誓，凭这只高山臂镯，我压根没存心！咱这一辈子的套套话，你真没贴衣近跟哪个姑娘说过么？没有！连对洗地板的美人鱼女佣也没有过？多么妙呀！我自己最亲、最疼、最爱说谎的心肝，只要你亲口告诉我，我自然信你。我活着就肯，哦，我爱就肯！听听，听听！我得低低说！不曾，不曾，只要我还记得那些亲亲流泪的脸，你尽可透过我看！整整白白的一辈子，在我无匹、又有一对的一生里，都不曾。若不，就叫这一时的果儿苦下去！凭我这身白，我向你求，拿我丝胸一系，我把你系住！常常，阿莫里，阿莫尔还要多！直至永远，你最爱！嘘嘘嘘嘘！只要那运锁匠。笑！

notes.lemma: I was always meant for an engindear from the French college, to be musband, nomme d'engien
notes.text: engindear 让工程师和亲爱在一声里，musband 近 must 和 husband。译文用「工程亲哥」「必夫」。nomme d’engien 与 encho tencho solver 保留近音，法语名号、契约说法待核。

notes.lemma: With my whiteness I thee woo and bind my silk breasths I thee bound! Always, Amory, amor andmore! Till always, thou lovest!
notes.text: 英国国教《公祷书》婚式中，新郎手持戒指说凭此戒指娶你，又说以身体敬你。小说保留宣誓式句法，改由说话人凭白、凭丝胸邀爱缚人；阿莫里及 amor 在誓后变奏。

notes.lemma: Shshshsh! So long as the lucksmith. Laughs!
notes.text: lucksmith 把幸运与锁匠拧在一起，可遥应爱情笑锁匠的说法。原文在 lucksmith 后落句点，随后另喊 Laughs，译文留停顿。

notes.lemma: And my waiting twenty classbirds, sitting on their stiles!
notes.text: 前句说二十只班鸟，点名从 Ada 到 Thelma 共二十八个，随后说 And Mee。译文同时保留二十、名单和末尾的我，照录声音里的数目错位。

segments.draft:
十一、倘若你在街头宿醉狂饮中，遇到一个来自病痛之邦、双目垂泪的可怜流亡汉，正当哀悼之月日渐亏蚀……你是否肯赏他一杯酒喝？
答曰：绝不，去你的吧！莫非你以为我有这般冲动天性，如蠢货般任凭一个冒牌骗子的抽泣所愚弄？我定要给他一顿当头棒喝！……

诸位且听我琼斯教授在此高谈阔论：身为笃信空间维度的博学之士，我坚信空间之巍然确凿远胜于时间之虚妄流转！鉴于诸位对爪哇语茫然无知，我愿将古老寓言大师的这则警世比喻，信笔翻译为通俗易懂的白话，倾囊相授。后生小辈，把头从书包里抬起来！仔细倾听，乔·彼得斯！领受真理！

《穆克思与格莱普斯》！
诸位贵胄与凡夫平民，句号信徒与分号诸君，混血种与笨水手！
segments.translation:
十一、倘你喝到兴头上，碰着一个艾林病乡来、眼疼流落的可怜人，他那支哆嗦调蹦得胫骨摇摇摆摆，他的反对头却趁他那一弱周的哀号发狂，活像咆咆哮哮、挥拳挥掌的莱昂·奥林；

倘他在愁毛毛雨里走念叨，诉自个儿的苦，又或扮狐弄虱，挑落膝头牙，又或拧着铐手求太平，这睁眼不见的倒霉人，拜迪厄夫与多姆诺斯楚姆，求点点东西填填嘴；

倘他跳着哭，又呜着呜着笑，把冷血过成蓝蓝星期一，骨无不带肉，领一吻、一块饼或一脚，吮一口、叹一声、抿嘴一笑，学是个魔难，欲是把小锄；

倘那乐意挨罪的胫骨人求你剃救他那不武不死、勉凑本领的小魂儿，嘴里哦呜、胡嘟嘟，放个破屁，使点狡计，偏爱那苦女人罪，咱想，琼斯，今晚不大乐意，你呢？

答曰：不，空你个头！这么说你以为我有冲动主义？有人告诉你我属第四十六分那帮？想来你也听见我的耳朵摇呀摇？想来他们还告诉你，我一生的名册不自然？然而，在我着手彻底驳倒这道循环乞题之前，你若真有胆量，倒不如迟疑一下，去别处参问同一个角币现钱问题，再试一试我的处置，当然得自然派地看，从这等出众的空间论者眨眼处看。

肖特，只要我略加指点，你从那里便会首先察觉：比奇森那套巧智学，虽说只受一股角币角币的冲劲驱使，也有他的现钱现钱性格斯特点——那是它为了权宜目的，从烈火教母厄运小姐（上回我们有幸与她有过一番别出心裁的小小交锋，对吧，肖特？）那里借来的；而且正如我本可以像背诵D.B.C.字母表那样干脆利落地告诉你，它行为派地亮着一层人样糖霜片，实际只偶然嘲讽了温斯坦那套「谁呜呜／哪儿的发」学说。

说得更直白笨拙一点：话形不过是个愁替身；而质性和这般性（下一句我自会连同恰当的何时、何地、何故、如何，向你剖析这词的应有之义）则随门径启闭，轮番心里索权、冒认。Talis（如此）这个字，有许多到处到处者常用滥（我正就此推演一套量子理论，因为眼下局面委实令人焦灼难耐）。某个悲观客或许常缠着你问：「近来你常常见到某某（Talis）与某某吗？」骨子里乐观的意思却是：「肯来三份爱尔兰酒么？」又或者当你装上弱音器蹑手蹑脚去试探某位食女色狼时，也许随口来一句：「劳驾递一下盘子？在火山口剧场登台献艺的吞剑客塔利斯·德·塔利斯，莫非就是那个每天跑一英里路、碾碎钢笔的塔利斯·冯·塔利斯——绝不唬你？」再举个例子吧，或许干净些。近来在一场后漩涡烧查，查一例已经定型的慢性斯宾诺病上，一位在外面讲《寒热》的讲师赫特·乌贝莱夫特博士，出于礼节惯例正试戴他的夹鼻眼镜，顺口借题发问道：「为何某某人的『如此』（talis）偏偏是『这般』（qualis）？」话音未落，粗围地的格丹克耶博士正擦着口哨喉，当即凭强权事实粗声反唇相讥：「只因你这畜生正是漩涡世界里的一声嗡鸣！」（Talis 与 Talis 本来同意，可说的是：Qualis。）

洛维—布吕勒教授（尽管我立刻能证明，他关于辛那赫里布有别于撒缦以色之卫生改革的全部论述，以及他在同一脉络下对「谢克尔先生与海德博士」双重人格难题的剖析，与我本人的研究硕果全然南辕北辙——至于我前往耶利哥的缘由，有些缘故须留作政治秘密——尤其考虑到因同样及其他缘由，卡文特里很快就会要我，我为此深感自豪——皆因他的学说再度无可救药地毁于我现在决意称之为「角币与现钞之钻石谬误」），在他那篇脱离禁闭逃逸问世后引起狮吼般轩然大波的口述自白《为何我生来不像个外邦绅士，又为何我如今对自己吃食如此直言不讳》（无花果树叶父子书局，犹大佩斯，A.M. 五六八八年）中，这位坦诚透风的老兄为了公众利益，一心脱下话袍和假发，叫我们看清：尽管正如他所言，「凭万般泔愿」，人类的肇端、堕落与终局膨胀暂且裹在淫秽迷雾之中，但只要透过电视远景镜（这具夜生活仪器在将较易折射的角度重新校准至其假说在外层锡皮上的尖叫声时，尚需做些减法改良）审视这些偶然表象，当我们借理性比例确信「我方体积之立方」与「彼等主体之表面」的比值，恰等于「此等球体之球度」（本学期我正极力推动一项议会动议，在我的指导下，该动议将确立礼貌体面在现代男女混杂病态化过程中的毒害性）与「费尔妮莉真空生发力」的比值时，我便能轻而易举、满怀赤诚地笃信我自身最广袤无垠的空间浩瀚性——那正是我的自家宅邸与极微宇宙。

倘若我无意间（我必须在此纠正整个新意大利派或古巴黎派那帮修补匠与斯宾格勒信徒的学派，他们妄称我之所以出错，是因为我出于对罗马狂热的反叛而偏要立异）踩踏了我的仇敌，我无需为此人类学式地致歉。赛克斯—魏曼—艾特尔纳基来的莱维—布鲁洛教授，F.D.，用手中纽伦堡蛋与炉上表锅做试验，发现：尽管表面看来这像是凯特叛乱冷却了教皇脊背，因为每周流通的古怪方信数目，绝不会因我手下圆顶泥块头们的卖力猛敲而显著增加。

那个衣衫褴褛的浪漫派像所有在缝里晃荡、寻停拍擒纵的汤姆汤皮昂那样苦苦企慕之物，以及他依照《亚瑟王之死》配意式肉肠传统向我们苦苦哀求的怜悯同情，统统是最拙劣平庸、浪费时间的勾当。他那双永远活在当下的脚趾头，总是从他早已过时的破皮靴里伸出来报复示威。听他呱呱乱叫！留神那个吞火投机客怎样胡乱挥棒！新兵高唱托利党歌！当年穆洛基赢下那两场伤风感冒，我们在三号更衣室脱衣之际，我固然想来一口入口即化的纯麦芽威士忌，却看不出何时才能如愿（我特意克制自己，不去阐发所涉两种可吞咽液体的比重谬误，也不去深究与皇家咽喉峡谷相关的酒液流失问题，尽管混合流体静力学与气动嗜酒学的学子们历经一番周折后，自会领悟我的高见）。默尔丁阿洛厄！正如老马尔塞拉斯·坎布里安努斯所言。

然而，照卢埃利斯·阿普·布里拉斯教授，F.D.、Ph. Dr，给的说法，那家伙就算提出抗辩，在旋律道义的尺度上也纯属胡扯与垃圾，因为他的「人之何时」绝非旁人的「何时尔」（算我的，多谢你？）；而哪怕情况相反我也毫不在乎，毕竟无论在情场还是战场，全是问「何处」——在我艺术高翔的平面上，你轻而易举便能唤起雷霆；我真诚依附之处，便是我攀登绿树之所；英诺森在哪儿看着最好（摘！），他那些眼常春里便有冬青。

小崽子，看样子我这番解释比你那一点领悟来得高——尽管这番论证如同卡德万、卡德瓦隆与卡德瓦洛纳三级递增那般无与伦比——我且退回比较爆粗的法子。我每逢得向糊涂班撒讲道，就常用这套。为了配合我的目的，且把你们自己想象成一帮流着鼻涕、鹅脖子、粗布脑袋、鞋带缠结、裤裆发痒的街头顽童，诸如此类、西塞罗云云。还有你，布鲁诺·诺兰，把你的舌头从墨水池里缩回来！既然你们没一位懂爪哇话，我就给各位讲老寓言家这个比喻，用我这轻轻松松、自由自在的译话。小阿勒博伊，把你的脑袋从书包里拔出来！听着，乔·彼得斯！侧耳倾听事实！

《穆克思与格莱普斯》。

列国诸君、平信众，句号人、半殖民分号人，杂种客、笨水手！
